Sandbox_DecayVehicle_CanopyDecayMulti_to: Determines decay speed when the vehicle is under a roof (protection from rain and UV).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayAutumnMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Autumn (baseline conditions).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayEngineExposedM: Minor penalty for engine bay when sheltered but the hood is open.
Multiplier for engine parts when the hood is open or missing outdoors.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayEngineProtecte: Decay reduction for engine parts when the hood is properly closed.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayExposedMulti_t: When enabled, interiors decay faster if windows/doors are missing or open.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayInteriorExpose: Minor decay penalty for open interiors even when sheltered (dust, humidity).
Multiplier for interior decay when exposed to outdoor elements like rain and UV.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayIntervalHours_: Frequency (in hours) at which the system calculates vehicle degradation. (435 = Every ~18 days, calibrated for full decay over 10-30 years in average conditions depending on part)
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierBatt: Decay rate for batteries (sulfation and discharge).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierBrak: Decay rate for brake discs and components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierDoor: Decay rate for all doors and panels.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierEngi: Decay rate for the vehicle hood.
Decay rate for internal engine components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierGasT: Decay rate for the fuel tank.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierGlov: Decay rate for the glove box compartment.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierHead: Decay rate for light lenses and bulbs.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierHeat: Decay rate for the heater core and cooling path.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierMuff: Decay rate for the exhaust system.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierRadi: Decay rate for electronics and radio components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierSusp: Decay rate for suspension and bushings.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierTire: Decay rate for rubber tires (dry rot and UV damage).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierTruc: Decay rate for rear truck beds.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierWhee: Decay rate for wheel rims (oxidation and corrosion).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierWind: Decay rate for tempered side glass.
Decay rate for laminated windshield glass.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayQualityMultipl: Decay speed multiplier for standard quality parts.
Decay speed multiplier applied to aged or worn parts.
Decay speed multiplier for premium/performance parts.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayRetroactive_to: If enabled, applies accumulated damage to vehicles based on the time elapsed since the apocalypse began.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecaySpringMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Spring (moisture and temperature swings).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecaySummerMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Summer (UV exposure and heat cycles).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeHea: Decay speed multiplier for trucks and heavy vehicles.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeSpo: Decay speed multiplier for performance and sport vehicles.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeSta: Baseline decay speed for normal passenger cars.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayWinterMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Winter (freeze-thaw and high humidity).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_IndoorDecayMulti_to: Determines decay speed when the vehicle is inside a room or garage. This should generally be lower than Shelter Effectiveness to reflect superior protection from humidity and temperature swings.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_ProtectionHours_too: Hours a vehicle remains exempt from decay after its last use. Set to 0 to disable protection.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustAccumulationRat: Base rate at which rust builds up on exposed metal parts.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustCosmeticDamage_: Base damage multiplier for metal parts when rust is in the cosmetic stage.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustDamageMultiplie: Scales how aggressively rust destroys parts after passing the threshold.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustDamageThreshold: Rust level (0-1) above which parts suffer accelerated structural damage.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustShelteredMultip: How much slower rust forms when the vehicle is sheltered.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeEnabled_tool: If enabled, vehicles left exposed to the sun will gradually lose paint saturation due to UV damage (simulating 80s/90s paint).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeMinSaturatio: The lowest color saturation limit (0.0 to 1.0) the vehicle paint can reach from sun fading. (Default: 0.50 = 50% saturation).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeRate_tooltip: Adjusts how quickly the vehicle paint fades over time. 1.0 simulates realistic fading over 10-15 years.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TallGrassRustEnable: If enabled, vehicles parked on tall grass will accumulate rust faster due to trapped moisture.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TallGrassRustMulti_: Multiplier for rust accumulation when parked on tall grass. (Default: 2.0x faster).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TireLowPressureDama: Accelerated decay multiplier applied when tires are underinflated.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TirePressureDamageT: Pressure level below which tires suffer structural damage from the vehicle's weight.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TirePressureDecay_t: Rate of natural air loss over time.
Sandbox_BagUpgradePlus_UpgradedBagSpawnC: Controls how often zombies carry upgraded bags. 0 = Never, 100 = Always. Default: 10 (Rare)
Sandbox_SN_BaseZombieCount_tooltip: How many zombies attack on your very first siege. Later sieges grow bigger based on the Growth Rate setting below. Example: 50 means about 50 zombies on siege #1.
Sandbox_SN_BreakerPercent_tooltip: The chance each zombie has to be a Breaker (wall smasher). 10% means roughly 1 in 10 zombies will be a breaker. Breakers wear construction gear and destroy barricades and walls faster than normal. Set to 0 to disable breakers.
Sandbox_SN_DirectionalAttacks_tooltip: When ON, zombies mostly attack from one direction each siege (North, South, East, or West). The direction is announced when the siege starts. Makes defending your base more strategic since you know which wall to fortify.
Sandbox_SN_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. Turn this OFF to completely disable all siege events.
Sandbox_SN_FirstSiegeDay_tooltip: Which in-game day the very first siege happens. Example: 5 means your first siege is on Day 5.
Sandbox_SN_FrequencyDaysMax_tooltip: The most days between siege nights. Leave at 0 to always use the Min value exactly (no randomness). Set higher than Min for unpredictable timing. Example: Min=3, Max=7 means a siege every 3 to 7 days.
Sandbox_SN_FrequencyDays_tooltip: The fewest days between siege nights. Example: 5 means at least 5 days between each siege. If you also set the Max value above 0, the gap will be random between Min and Max.
Sandbox_SN_MaxActiveZombies_tooltip: The most siege zombies that can be alive at the same time. When this limit is reached, new zombies stop spawning until you kill some. Lower values = smoother performance and steadier action. Higher values = more overwhelming but can cause lag. Default: 400. If your game stutters during sieges, try lowering this.
Sandbox_SN_MaxZombies_tooltip: The absolute maximum number of zombies that can appear in a single siege night, no matter how far you've progressed. Once this many have spawned, the siege is over. Think of this as the siege length cap. Example: 800 means the siege ends after 800 zombies total.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_ActivityScaling_too: When ON, mini-hordes are bigger when you've been busy (killing zombies, shooting, running generators). If you've been quiet, mini-hordes are smaller.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_CooldownMinutes_too: How many in-game minutes must pass after a mini-horde before another one can trigger. Prevents back-to-back attacks. Default: 60 minutes.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_Enabled_tooltip: Adds small zombie attacks between siege nights, triggered by noise you make. Running generators, firing guns, driving vehicles, and being generally loud can attract nearby zombies to your location. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_EstablishmentScalin: When ON, the more built-up your base is (generators, loot, defenses), the bigger your sieges and mini-hordes become. Building a bigger base attracts more attention.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_MaxPerDay_tooltip: The most mini-hordes that can happen in one in-game day. Resets at midnight. Set to 0 for no daily limit. Default: 2.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_MaxZombies_tooltip: Maximum zombies in one mini-horde (at maximum noise). Default: 35.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_MinZombies_tooltip: Minimum zombies in a mini-horde (at threshold noise). Default: 8.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_NoiseThreshold_tool: How much noise you need to make before a mini-horde shows up. Lower numbers = mini-hordes come more easily (even quiet activity triggers them). Higher numbers = only very loud activities like gunfire and vehicle crashes attract them. Default: 100.
Sandbox_SN_MiniHorde_PlayerScaling_toolt: Multiplayer only. When ON, more online players means bigger mini-hordes.
Sandbox_SN_SafehouseMergeDistance_toolti: Only matters when Zombie Target is set to Safehouse. If two safehouses are closer together than this distance, they're treated as one target. Prevents zombies from awkwardly splitting between buildings that are right next to each other. Default: 50.
Sandbox_SN_SafehouseSearchRadius_tooltip: Only matters when Zombie Target is set to Safehouse. How far away the mod looks for your claimed safehouse. If your base isn't being targeted during sieges, try increasing this. Default: 300.
Sandbox_SN_ScalingMultiplier_tooltip: How much harder each siege gets compared to the last. At 1.5: Siege 1 = 50 zombies, Siege 2 = 75, Siege 3 = 112, Siege 4 = 168, and so on. Set to 1.0 if you want every siege to stay the same size. In multiplayer, more players also means more zombies.
Sandbox_SN_SharedSpawnRadius_tooltip: Multiplayer only. Players within this distance of each other fight the SAME siege together. If players are farther apart than this, each group gets their own separate siege. Default: 200. Increase if your group is spread across a large compound.
Sandbox_SN_SiegeEndHour_tooltip: What hour the siege ends and any remaining zombies are cleared, using 24-hour time. Default: 6 (6:00 AM). The siege can also end early if you kill all the zombies before this time.
Sandbox_SN_SiegeMode_option1: Per-Base: Each player group fights their own siege
Sandbox_SN_SiegeMode_option2: Unified: Everyone shares one big siege
Sandbox_SN_SiegeMode_tooltip: How sieges work in multiplayer. Per-Base: each group of nearby players fights their own independent siege with separate waves and kills. Unified: ALL players share one global siege — waves, kills, and progress are combined. The unified siege targets wherever the most players and infrastructure are concentrated.
Sandbox_SN_SiegeStartHour_tooltip: What hour the siege begins, using 24-hour time. Default: 20 (8:00 PM). Set to 22 for a late-night start, or 18 for early evening.
Sandbox_SN_SiegeWeatherEnabled_tooltip: Adds spooky weather during siege nights — fog rolls in before the siege, rain and wind pick up during combat, and everything clears at dawn. This is purely visual and does NOT affect gameplay difficulty.
Sandbox_SN_SiegeWeatherIntensity_tooltip: How dramatic the weather effects are. 1.0 = normal. 0.5 = subtle effects. 2.0 = thick fog and heavy rain. Set to 0 to effectively disable weather without turning off the setting above.
Sandbox_SN_SpawnAnchor_option1: Players: Zombies chase you wherever you go
Sandbox_SN_SpawnAnchor_option2: Safehouse: Zombies attack your claimed base, even if you leave
Sandbox_SN_SpawnAnchor_tooltip: What zombies focus on during a siege.
Sandbox_SN_SpawnDistance_tooltip: How far from your position zombies appear when the siege starts. Higher values give you more time to see them coming. If you have a large base, increase this so zombies don't appear inside your walls. Default: 45. Most bases work well between 40-60.
Sandbox_SN_SpecialZombiesEnabled_tooltip: Adds tougher zombie types to siege nights: Sprinters (fast runners), Breakers (smash through walls), and Tanks (huge and hard to kill). These spawn mixed in with regular zombies.
Sandbox_SN_SpecialZombiesStartWeek_toolt: Which siege number special zombies start appearing. Example: 3 means your first two sieges are normal zombies only, and specials show up starting on siege #3. Gives new players time to get ready.
Sandbox_SN_SprinterPercent_tooltip: The chance each zombie has to be a Sprinter (fast runner). 5% means roughly 1 in 20 zombies will sprint at you. Sprinters look like regular zombies but move much faster. Set to 0 to disable sprinters.
Sandbox_SN_StripSiegeZombieLoot_tooltip: Removes extra items from siege zombies (they keep their clothes). Turn this ON if siege zombies are dropping too much loot, especially if you have mods that add items to zombie inventories.
Sandbox_SN_TankCount_tooltip: How many Tank zombies appear each siege night. Tanks wear military gear, move slowly, but take many hits to kill. They show up during the last third of the night. Set to 0 to disable tanks.
Sandbox_SN_TankHealthMultiplier_tooltip: How many times tougher a Tank is compared to a regular zombie. At 5.0, a Tank takes about 5 times as many hits to kill. Increase for a real bullet sponge, decrease if tanks feel impossible.
Sandbox_SN_WarningSignsEnabled_tooltip: When ON, your character will mutter and you'll hear distant sounds during the day before a siege night. This gives you time to prepare and get back to base.
Sandbox_SN_WaveBreakSeconds_tooltip: How long (in seconds) the longest pause between attack waves can be. Leave at 0 for automatic pacing (5-12 seconds between waves). Set a specific number to cap it, e.g. 5 means waves always come within 5 seconds. Note: zombies still trickle in during pauses.

whether the lock on fence gates can be cut open
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Allow_Fences_t: whether bolt cutters can be used to destroy fence sections
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Allow_Garage_D: allow cutting locks on garage doors

Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Allow_Shutters: whether the lock on security shutters over doors and windows can be cut open, the shutters will be destroyed
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Base_Duration_: how many seconds it will take, before strength is factored in
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Base_Muscle_St: how much muscle strain will be applied, before strength is factored in
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Easy_Strength_: a character must have at least this level of strength to perform easy actions, like cutting thin wire fences
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Fence_Wire_Cha: the percentage chance to drop a resource when destroying a fence section, 0 to disable
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Hard_Strength_: a character must have at least this level of strength to perform challenging actions, like cutting thick fences
Sandbox_DGMC_Bolt_Cutters_Medium_Strengt: a character must have at least this level of strength to perform moderate actions, like cutting locks
Sandbox_JH_Enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable horde night events.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceEnabled_tooltip: Allow Fragrance A la Jeeves bottles to spawn in the world. When disabled, existing bottles still function but no new ones will appear in loot.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceSpawnRate_tooltip: Relative spawn weight (1 = extremely rare, 100 = common). Default 10. Fragrance spawns at half the vanilla Cologne weight in each location, then scaled by this value.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMax_tooltip: Maximum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMin_tooltip: Minimum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_HordeImmunityEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, players can consume Zombie Stew to gain immunity from the current horde event. No zombies will target them and no lure pulses will emit around them.
Sandbox_JH_LureIntervalTicks_tooltip: How often (in game ticks) a lure pulse is emitted during the horde event.
Sandbox_JH_LureRadius_tooltip: Radius of the sound lure that draws zombies toward players.
Sandbox_JH_LureVolume_tooltip: Volume of the sound lure. Higher values attract zombies from further away.
Sandbox_JH_PreventSleep_tooltip: If enabled, players cannot sleep while the warning moodle is active. Prevents skipping the horde event by sleeping through it. Disable if you want players to be able to sleep through events at their own risk.
Sandbox_JH_RottenFleshChance_tooltip: Percentage chance (0-100) that a zombie drops Rotten Flesh when killed. Default 5 means 5% of zombie kills yield the item.
Sandbox_JH_SafeRadius_tooltip: Radius (in tiles) around each player that is checked to be clear before spawning.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMax_tooltip: Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMin_tooltip: Minimum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_StartDay_tooltip: The first in-game day horde events can begin.
Sandbox_JH_SurvivorMultiplierMax_tooltip: Maximum zombie multiplier a player can earn from surviving hordes. Each survival adds +0.1x. Default 15.0 means up to 16x zombies at max.
Sandbox_JH_WarnPlayers_tooltip: If enabled, players receive a warning message and moodle before the horde arrives.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCountMax_tooltip: Maximum zombies per player regardless of increment stacking.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCount_tooltip: Base number of zombies spawned per online player during a horde event.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieIncrement_tooltip: Additional zombies added to the count after each horde event.
Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip: Quickly applies a tuned set of values for toxic and attack events.
Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti: Default duration in game hours when HTT starts an event.
Sandbox_DisableEventsDuringSleep_tooltip: When enabled, automatic event starts and toxic ambient loops are paused while players are sleeping or time is fast-forwarded.
Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti: Allows the air bombardment helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip: Allows the downed helicopter crash event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt: Allows the electromagnetic interference (EMI) event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt: Allows the fuel reclamation helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip: Allows the hostile helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt: Allows the incendiary sweep event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike: Allows the military vehicle strike helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t: Allows the propaganda broadcast event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSmokeCurtainEvent_too: Allows the smoke curtain event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip: Allows the sniper cover event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip: Allows the support attack helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSurveillanceEvent_too: Allows the surveillance event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip: Allows the toxic helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip: Allows the UAV scan event to run and broadcast zombie density reports by radio.
Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti: When enabled, automatic HTT events ignore cooldowns and try to start once every in-game day at the fixed hour below.
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_: If enabled, incendiary sweeps can land in a reduced but still safe range near players; players are never directly targeted.
Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch for this mod. If disabled, HTT will not start events.
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti: When enabled, each vanilla-triggered HTT event uses a random cooldown between 6 hours and the value configured in Time Between Events.
Sandbox_EnableVanillaHelicopterHook_tool: When enabled, a vanilla helicopter activation can trigger one HTT event while the vanilla helicopter keeps running.
Sandbox_EventCooldownHours_tooltip: In-game hours between vanilla-triggered HTT events. Valid range: 6 to 168. If random cooldown is enabled, this value becomes the upper bound of the random range.
Sandbox_EventWeightHostileAttack_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the hostile helicopter attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightSupportAttack_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the support attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightToxic_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the toxic event.
Sandbox_FixedDailyEventHour_tooltip: In-game hour used by the fixed daily scheduler. Example: 9.50 = 09:30.
Sandbox_FuelReclamationDrainPercent_tool: Fuel percentage drained from loaded gas pumps when the fuel reclamation helicopter completes extraction.
Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip: Chance that a hostile burst lands a hit. Rolled once per burst.
Sandbox_MilitaryVehicleStrikeChance_tool: Chance that the military vehicle strike event will execute the attack when a valid military vehicle is found.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageCurvePower_tooltip: Damage curve exponent: higher values are gentler at low exposure and harsher near max.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip: Minimum per-minute toxic player damage once exposure passes the damage threshold.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu: Base player health damage per minute when toxic exposure is at 100%.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip: Legacy zombie toxic damage per tick. Player toxic damage uses the per-minute options below.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip: Applies preset toxic damage/exposure and tick pacing values for quick balancing.
Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip: Duration in game hours used by toxic helicopter events. Other events still use Event Duration Hours.
Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip: How fast toxic exposure builds per minute while unprotected.
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx: Small extra per-minute damage when exposure is very high (>= 90%).
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too: Legacy compatibility value. Prefer the per-minute toxic damage options below.
Sandbox_ToxicTickSeconds_tooltip: Seconds between each toxic damage/exposure server tick.
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents: Use Vanilla Rotor In HTT Events
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents_to: Disabled by default. If enabled, replaces HTT rotor sounds with Project Zomboid's vanilla helicopter rotor sound. Non-rotor HTT cues stay unchanged.
Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip: Chance (0-100) that a vanilla helicopter trigger starts an HTT event.
Sandbox_M250_DamageMultiplier_tooltip: Percentage of base damage. 100 = normal, 50 = half, 200 = double. Default: 100
Sandbox_M250_Durability_tooltip: Maximum weapon condition. Higher = lasts longer before breaking. Default: 35
Sandbox_M250_FireRate_tooltip: Full-auto cyclic rate (value / 100). Higher = faster. 90 = 0.9x. Default: 90
Sandbox_M250_JamChance_tooltip: Chance for the weapon to jam per shot (value / 10). 8 = 0.8, 0 = never jams. Default: 8
Sandbox_M250_LootAmmo_tooltip: Spawn weight for XM1186 ammo boxes and cartons. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootAttachment_tooltip: Spawn weight for the XM157 scope. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootMagazine_tooltip: Spawn weight for the M250 magazine. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootWeapon_tooltip: Spawn weight for the M250 weapon. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_MagazineSize_tooltip: Number of rounds the M250 magazine holds. Default: 100
Sandbox_M250_MagazineWeight_tooltip: Weight of the M250 magazine in tenths of kg (25 = 2.5 kg). Default: 25
Sandbox_M250_RecoilDelay_tooltip: Delay between shots caused by recoil (in ticks). Lower = less recoil. Default: 18
Sandbox_M250_ScrewdriverRequired_tooltip: Require a screwdriver to attach/detach the XM157 scope.
Sandbox_M250_SingleFireOnly_tooltip: Disables full-auto mode, forcing single-fire only.
Sandbox_M250_SoundRange_tooltip: How far zombies can hear the M250 when fired. Default: 50
Sandbox_M250_SpawnGunStore_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in gun stores (rifle displays, ammo shelves, accessories).
Sandbox_M250_SpawnHunting_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in hunting and outdoor stores.
Sandbox_M250_SpawnMilitary_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in military locations (army barracks, army storage, surplus stores).
Sandbox_M250_SpawnPawnShop_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in pawn shops.
Sandbox_M250_SpawnPolice_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in police stations (gun storage, ammo storage).
Sandbox_M250_StartAmmo_tooltip: Number of XM1186 ammo boxes (20 rounds each) to start with. Default: 0
Sandbox_M250_StartMags_tooltip: Number of loaded M250 magazines to start with. Default: 0
Sandbox_M250_StartWithAttachment_tooltip: Start the game with an XM157 scope. Requires 'Start with M250' to be enabled.
Sandbox_M250_StartWithWeapon_tooltip: Start the game with an M250 Light Machine Gun in your inventory.
Sandbox_M250_WeaponWeight_tooltip: Weight of the M250 in tenths of kg (66 = 6.6 kg). Default: 66
Sandbox_CalmPhaseIcon_tooltip: Shows the icon for the calm phase when this phase is in place.
Sandbox_LoggingFrequency_tooltip: Interval between printing debug information into the logs (in-game minutes).
Sandbox_PhaseUpdateFrequency_tooltip: Interval between zombie attraction updates for specified phase (in-game minutes).
Sandbox_StormAlertSound_tooltip: Allows the sound effects to played at the start of the storm phase.
Sandbox_StormPhaseIcon_tooltip: Shows the icon for the storm phase when this phase is in place.
Sandbox_AHS_EnableFloatingWarnings_toolt: Shows Advanced Health character speech warnings for health changes and habit risks. Disable this to keep the sidebar attention without spoken warning spam.
Sandbox_AHS_UIToggleKey_tooltip: Key used to open/close the Advanced Health panel.
Sandbox_EnableFloatingWarnings_tooltip: Shows Advanced Health character speech warnings for health changes and habit risks. Disable this to keep the sidebar attention without spoken warning spam.
Sandbox_UIToggleKey_tooltip: Key used to open/close the Advanced Health panel.

Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ContainerSpawnRa: How often dossier pages spawn inside world containers (police lockers, military storage, hospital cabinets, fire dept lockers). This is separate from zombie drops.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Firef: Chance that a firefighter zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Firefighter dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: axe, sledgehammer, crowbar, fireman gear, blow torch.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Medic: Chance that a doctor or nurse zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Medical dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: antibiotics, bandages, painkillers, surgical tools.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Milit: Chance that a military zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Military dossier requires 3 pages to assemble. Rewards: assault rifles, ammo, camo gear, military backpack.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Polic: Chance that a police zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Police dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: pistols, shotguns, ammo, police gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Range: Chance that a ranger zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Ranger dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: hunting rifle, shotguns, knife, hatchet, ranger gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ProximityRadius_: How close (in tiles) you must be to a stash location to collect the reward (5-50). Default: 15 tiles. Lower = harder to find, higher = easier. Players get color-coded proximity hints as they approach.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_RewardRarity_too: Multiplier applied to all stash reward drop chances. Generous doubles the chances, Minimal makes only the most common items drop.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_UseCustomRewards: When enabled, stash rewards are loaded from the config file at Zomboid/Lua/DeadMansDossier_Rewards.cfg instead of using the built-in reward tables. The config file is auto-generated with defaults on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or change reward items and their drop chances. The Reward Rarity multiplier still applies on top.
Sandbox_JordanalSpawns.UmbrellaCorp_Unit: Umbrella Corp Unit spawn chance in percentage for military and general areas
Its percentual, but it does share its chance with other outfits, so at 100 you will never get only zombies with this outfits
Sandbox_PhunLewt_Debug_tooltip: Print verbose output into logs. Useful for... well, debugging
Sandbox_PhunCure_CureBite_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will heal body part bite
Sandbox_PhunCure_CureInfection_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will remove the knox virus
Sandbox_PhunCure_CureScratch_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will heal any scratch
Sandbox_PhunCure_CureWound_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will remove any infected wound (eg instead of using anti biotics). This is different to the knox virus
Sandbox_PhunCure_DaysFresh_tooltip: Number of days that the cure is considered fresh. Currently has no benefit. Default is 1 day. Note that changing this value only applies after a restart and to newly created items
Sandbox_PhunCure_DaysRotten_tooltip: Number of days the cure is good for without keeping in fridge or freezer. Set to 0 or a crazy high number to disable (default is 4 days). Note this value only applies after a restart and only to newly created items
Sandbox_PhunCure_DefDropRate_tooltip: The chance out of 100 of a cure carrying zed appearing. eg 10 = 10%, 5.5 = 5.5%
Sandbox_PhunCure_DefSprinterDropRate_too: The chance out of 100 that the sprinter is packing a cure. eg 10 = 10%, 5.5 = 5.5%. Only applies if PhunSprinters is installed and rate differs from default
Sandbox_PhunCure_ExpiredChance_tooltip: The chance (out of 100) that the cure will already be rotten which can further increase rarity. Note that if you disabled rotting below (eg Days to Rot = 0) then this value will have no affect. 0 means they will always be fresh, 50 means that half of the cures found will be unusable
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_AddToLoot_tooltip: If Always Show UI is disabled, tick this so that Military Issued sensor will appear in loot. Wearing these will show the UI. Requires restart. If you do not want any UI, disable this and the Always Show UI option
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_AlwaysShowElements: Always display the UI component in the upper right screen. Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_DarknessLevel_tool: Adjusted light level where all sprinters will run
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Debug_tooltip: Print verbosely (useful when diagnosing issues). Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Decorate_tooltip: Dress the sprinters up around the holidays (only works with certain additional mods active and installed)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_DefaultRisk_toolti: Percentage chance of a zed being a sprinter. If you use PhunZones, this is the fallback risk level when no other value is specified by a zone (or its parent). Examples: 0 = no chance. 50 = 50% chance and 100 = always
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_FrequencyOfEnvUpda: Number of seconds before recalculating enviromental changes like light and fog. Increase for improved performance
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_HoursDiscount_tool: The number of hours (across all characters) until risk level is fully applied. For example, if this value is 240 (10 game days) then on the fifth day of play (regardless of how many times they have died), the effective risk that a player is reduced by 50%. Leave blank or 0 to ignore
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MaxDistance_toolti: The maximum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to improve performance trying to process zeds that are too far away)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MaxQueue_tooltip: The max number of zeds to update per tick
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MinDistance_toolti: The minimum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to prevent sudden popins)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Mode_option4: When its too dark around them ***
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Mode_tooltip: This option governs when sprinters will run. ** = low performance impact, *** = med-high performance impact depending on population
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseCrescent_: Adjust risk on nights with a crescent moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50% while 200 would be 200% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseFull_tool: Adjust risk on nights with a full moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50% while 200 would be 200% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseGibbous_t: Adjust risk on nights with a gibbous moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50% while 200 would be 200% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseNew_toolt: Adjust risk on nights with a new moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50% while 200 would be 200% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseQuarter_t: Adjust risk on nights with a first quarter moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50% while 200 would be 200% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Skeletons_tooltip: All sprinters appear as Skeletons. CURRENTLY DISABLED AS BUG IN VANILLA CAN CAUSE A CLIENT CRASH WHEN AIMING AT A SKELETON
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_SlowInLight_toolti: If sprinter is running, light over your darkness level (eg a flashlight) can force them to walk (until its too dark again). Note that this is basically included in the tile based mode above
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_SprintingChangeNot: Volume of the sound that notifies players that sprinters are no longer running (eg day) or that they have now started to run (eg night or bad weather). Set to 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Volume_tooltip: Volume of sprinter screech. 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunZones_Debug_tooltip: Increase verbosity of logging to help diagnose issues. Best to leave off otherwise
Sandbox_PhunZones_EditorRole_tooltip: If set, only players whose role name matches this value (case-insensitive) can open the zone editor. Leave empty to allow all players that have access to admin/debug menu (or always allow in singleplayer).
Sandbox_PhunZones_MaxDifficulty_tooltip: Maximum number of difficulty. This is the max number of pips in your widget (default is 4)
Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowDifficulty_tooltip: Show difficulty level for zone as pips in widget. Requires Show Widget to be ticked.
Sandbox_PhunZones_UpdateInterval_tooltip: The number of seconds between scanning for zone changes. 1 should be more than fine
Sandbox_PhunZones_Widget_tooltip: Displays a moveable widget that displays the current zones title and subtitle. It can also show pips that signify the danger level for the current zone
Sandbox_TanksHavePropane_AllowGasPumps_t: If enabled, propane tanks and blowtorches can also be refilled at gas station pumps (in addition to propane storage tanks).
Sandbox_TanksHavePropane_AllowSmallIndus: Allow refilling at small industrial propane tanks
If enabled, propane tanks and blowtorches can also be refilled at small industrial propane tanks found in factories and warehouses.
Sandbox_TanksHavePropane_SearchRadius_to: How far (in tiles) to search for a propane source around the item on the ground.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseBudge: How many zombies each player pulse may actively redirect.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseEnabl: Enables the recurring player-centered movement pulse that keeps nearby zombies active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseMinSt: Minimum evolution stage required before the player pulse can affect a zombie.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseRadiu: Radius around each player scanned by the pulse system.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseScanB: Maximum zombies scanned globally by the player pulse each interval.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderBaseChance: Base chance for an idle zombie to start a wander directive when its cooldown is ready.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderCooldownMi: Base cooldown between ambient wander directives.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderCooldownRa: Extra random cooldown added on top of the base wander cooldown.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderDirectTarg: Chance to convert ambient pressure into direct pursuit when conditions are met.
Distance where ambient systems can switch from area pressure to direct player pursuit.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderHomingRadi: Distance within which ambient systems can bias zombies toward the player.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderMaxTravel_: Maximum travel distance for ambient wander paths.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderMinTravel_: Minimum travel distance for ambient wander paths.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderPathBudget: Maximum ambient path requests issued per second. Lower values reduce CPU cost.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CohesionDriftEnabled_to: Allows nearby zombies to drift toward local groups for denser movement.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CohesionDriftPathBudget: Maximum cohesion-drift path requests issued per second.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchLeaderBudget_t: Maximum leader zombies processed per batch.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchProcessingEnab: Processes zombies in rotating batches instead of evaluating all of them continuously.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchZombieBudget_t: Maximum non-leader zombies processed per batch.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreLeaderProcessInterv: Minimum interval between leader logic updates.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreLeaderShardCount_to: How many scheduler shards leaders are split into. Higher values reduce leader CPU usage.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreZombieProcessInterv: Minimum interval between non-leader logic updates.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreZombieShardCount_to: How many scheduler shards passive zombies are split into. Higher values reduce per-tick load.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableAmbientWander_too: Enables passive roaming pressure and player-centered movement logic.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugLogs_tooltip: Emits Dynamic Evolution Z diagnostic logs to the console/log files. This does not enable admin debug commands or overlays, and the quick preset will not override it.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugMode_tooltip: Allows Dynamic Evolution Z debug commands and admin overlay tools. This setting is not overridden by the quick preset.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaderNameText_to: Shows a local visual text label over nearby leaders with their archetype, using the zombie speech bubble style.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaderSounds_tool: Enables leader vocal cues and archetype sound events.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaders_tooltip: Allows rare leader promotions and influence pulses.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableMigration_tooltip: Master switch for Dynamic Z migration and movement redirection systems.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_KillFactor_tooltip: World evolution gained from kills. Value 5 = 0.0005, value 10 = 0.0010.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderRadius_tooltip: Radius used by leaders to scan and influence nearby zombies.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderWorldThreshold_to: Minimum world evolution required before leaders can start appearing.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderZombiesPerLeader_: Approximate active zombie count required for one leader slot. Lower values create more leaders.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationCooldownHours_: Minimum hours before a leader can start another migration.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationDurationHours_: How long migration state remains active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationIntensity_tool: Overall migration aggressiveness. Higher values favor stronger and faster movement.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationKillThreshold_: Recent kills required before a zone can become a migration target.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationKillWindowHour: How long kills remain valid for migration scoring.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationPercentage_too: Percent of eligible followers redirected during migration.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationRadius_tooltip: Chunk radius scanned around leaders for migration targets.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PlayerPressure_tooltip: Builds territorial pressure around active players. Higher levels intensify local zombie response.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PresetProfile_tooltip: Applies a full Dynamic Z preset over the sandbox values at load time. Select Custom to edit each value manually.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_TimeFactor_tooltip: Passive world evolution gained over time. Value 5 = 0.005, value 10 = 0.010.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableMuscleStra: When enabled, heavier armor adds extra vanilla melee muscle strain during combat. Turn this off to remove the armor-based strain effect.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableSleepPenal: When enabled, sleeping in restrictive armor reduces overnight endurance recovery and increases next-day fatigue. Turn this off to remove the armor-based sleep penalty.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableSystem_too: Applies armor-related physical costs to endurance and sleep recovery.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableThermalMod: When enabled, armor amplifies endurance drain in hot conditions based on thermoregulator state. Turn this off to remove all thermal burden scaling from armor.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_AnimalDamageMultiplier_: Scales hazard damage applied to animals.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_BypassUtilitiesRequirem: If enabled, random hazards can occur before utilities are shut off.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_DiminishingSpawnsOverTi: Gradually lowers event frequency/chance as world age increases.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_EnableFalloutEvents_too: Allows random Fallout events to spawn.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_EnableHeavyGasEvents_to: Allows random Heavy Gas events to spawn.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_EnableLightGasEvents_to: Allows random Light Gas events to spawn.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_EnableSmokeEvents_toolt: Enables smoke hazard events generated by active fire sources.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_FalloutCropDamageEnable: If enabled, active Fallout can stress and damage crops.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_FalloutDriftSpeed_toolt: Movement speed multiplier for Fallout clouds. 0 keeps them stationary.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_FalloutIndoorProtection: Fraction of Fallout exposure blocked while indoors (0 = none, 1 = full).
Sandbox_ToxicSky_FalloutIntervalHours_to: Hours between Fallout event roll attempts.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_FilterSaturationThresho: Minimum remaining filter percent required for full protection.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_GasDiminishChanceDays_t: World-age interval (in days) used to reduce event spawn chance over time.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_GasDiminishIntervalDays: World-age interval (in days) used to reduce event frequency over time.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_GasMaskDamagePerHit_too: Durability damage applied to gas masks per toxic exposure tick.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_HeavyGasDurationMaxHour: Maximum duration for Heavy Gas events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_HeavyGasDurationMinHour: Minimum duration for Heavy Gas events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_HeavyGasIntervalHours_t: Hours between Heavy Gas event roll attempts.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyDamageMode_toolti: Uses legacy direct health damage instead of toxicity-based progression.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyHealthDamageMulti: Multiplier applied to legacy direct health damage.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyHealthDamagePerTi: Base direct health damage dealt each legacy damage tick.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LightGasDurationMaxHour: Maximum duration for Light Gas events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LightGasDurationMinHour: Minimum duration for Light Gas events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_PlayerToxicityValue_too: Base toxicity applied to players per hazard tick before multipliers.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_RandomEventsEnabled_too: Enables or disables Toxic Sky random hazard events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmallLeakIntervalHours_: Hours between Light Gas event roll attempts.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeActiveScanMinutes_: Minutes between smoke source scans while an active fire source exists.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeDormantScanMinutes: Minutes between smoke source scans while no active source is detected.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeLingerMinutes_tool: How long smoke zones persist after fire sources stop burning.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeMaxSources_tooltip: Maximum number of simultaneous smoke sources tracked.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeMaxSquaresPerScan_: Safety cap for world squares processed per smoke scan.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeOutdoorToxicityMul: Toxicity multiplier applied to outdoor smoke exposure.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_SmokeScanRadiusTiles_to: Search radius around tracked smoke sources, in tiles.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_UseSandboxOverrides_too: OFF: use in-game ModOptions/saved config. ON: use Toxic Sky sandbox values as authoritative.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_VehicleExposureMultipli: Scales exposure while inside vehicles (0 = full protection, 1 = no reduction).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertEnabled_tooltip: Show supply drop events as large centered text on screen (like admin server messages).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertMessageEnd_tool: Message shown on screen when a supply drop expires or is removed.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertMessageStart_to: Message shown on screen when a supply drop is announced. Use {x} and {y} for drop coordinates.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_CallAirdropCooldown_: Minimum minutes after any supply drop ends before a player can call a new airdrop. Uses the same time mode as Event Frequency. Set to 0 for no cooldown.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_CallAirdropEnabled_t: Allow players to use a fully charged radio to call in an immediate supply drop. The radio is destroyed after use.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperLeaveRadius_t: How close a player must get to the crate for the helicopter to leave (5–50 tiles). Only used when 'Chopper Leaves on Arrival' is enabled. Smaller = chopper stays longer (player must be right on top of the crate). Larger = chopper leaves earlier (as soon as anyone is in visual range).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperLeavesOnArriv: When enabled, the helicopter flies off the moment a player reaches the drop zone — rotor sound stops and zombies are no longer attracted to the area. The crate remains until despawn. Lets players push through the horde and reclaim the area instead of fighting an endless siren.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperPattern_toolt: How the helicopter sound moves at the drop site. Static keeps it fixed on the crate. Orbit makes it circle around the drop site, spreading zombies out instead of stacking them on one spot.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_DespawnTimer_tooltip: Minutes before an uncollected supply crate disappears. Uses the same time mode as Event Frequency.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_Enabled_tooltip: Master kill switch. When disabled, NO drops occur — random, radio, or admin.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_EventFrequency_toolt: Minutes between supply drop events. In Real Time mode this is wall-clock minutes. In Game Time mode this is in-game minutes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_HelicopterVolume_too: Volume of the helicopter sound as a percentage. 100 = full volume, 0 = silent. The game's SFX slider scales on top of this. Lower if the helicopter is drowning out other game audio.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_LootQuantity_tooltip: Number of random items placed in each supply crate. Items are picked randomly from a large pool of weapons, armor, supplies, and consumables.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MaxDistance_tooltip: Maximum distance from a player where a supply drop can appear. Too far and players may not reach it in time.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MinDistance_tooltip: Minimum distance from a player where a supply drop can appear. Prevents drops on top of players.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MinPlayers_tooltip: Supply drops only occur when at least this many players are online. Useful for skipping events during solo play.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioCharges_tooltip: Number of times a radio can be used to Tune In before its battery is depleted and the radio is destroyed.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioDropChance_tool: Percentage chance for a Chopper Drop Radio to appear on military zombie corpses. Higher values mean more radios in the world.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioEnabled_tooltip: Enable or disable the Chopper Drop Radio item. When disabled, radios will not spawn and all radio features are inactive.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioHeadStart_toolt: Seconds of advance notice radio holders get before the drop location is announced to everyone. Set to 0 to disable early intel.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RandomEventsEnabled_: When disabled, the timer-based random drops stop. Radio (Tune In / Request Airdrop) and admin commands still work — drops only happen on demand. Useful for radio-only / pure on-demand setups.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SoundRadius_tooltip: How far away players can hear the helicopter sound. Larger values let players hear it from further away.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnFailAlertMessag: Message shown on screen when a supply drop is cancelled due to a bad landing zone.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnFailAlert_toolt: Show a screen alert to all players when a supply drop is cancelled due to a bad landing zone (water, no walkable tile).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnRetryDelay_tool: If the drop location lands on water or has no valid tile, the event is cancelled and retried after this many minutes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_TimerMode_tooltip: How event timers are measured. Real Time uses wall-clock minutes. Game Time uses in-game minutes (affected by day length and game speed).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_UseCustomLoot_toolti: Load the loot pool from ChopperDrop_Loot.cfg instead of the built-in item list. The config file is auto-generated in Zomboid/Lua/ on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or comment out items. Requires server restart after changes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ZombieAttractionRadi: How far the helicopter noise attracts zombies. Larger values pull zombies from a wider area.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ZombieHordeSize_tool: Number of zombies spawned at the drop site when a player arrives. Set to 0 to disable horde spawning.
Sandbox_SD_SpawnChance_tooltip: Common:1.5x, Uncommon:1.0x, Rare:0.5x, Very Rare:0.25x, default value is 1x
Sandbox_UnifiedCarryWeightFramework_CapW: PZ hardcoded on java-side to not allow player to carry more than 50kg/lb of items. If you run java mod that removes this limit, then you don't have to cap max weight at 50 and you should uncheck this box.
Sandbox_UnifiedCarryWeightFramework_Gath: Enables prints into console. Useful for debug purposes. You generally don't want to have this enabled during normal gameplay as it provides no useful information for players and just bloats the console file.

Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_BatteryTypes_toolt: Semicolon-separated list of supported battery types. Format: fullType:defaultAh[:capacityModDataKey]. Example: Base.CarBattery1:50;ISA.DIYBattery:200:ISA_maxCapacity
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_BulbLifespanMult_t: Multiplier applied on top of the vanilla LightBulbLifespan setting. 1.0 = same as regular light fixtures. 2.0 = bulbs last twice as long. 0 = bulbs never burn out. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_BulbTypes_tooltip: Semicolon-separated list of additional item fullTypes to accept as lightbulbs (for mods that don't use 'LightBulb' in the name). Leave empty for vanilla bulbs only.
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_CondLossOnZero_too: Base condition loss when battery charge hits 0% before Ah scaling is applied. Scaled by 1/(Ah/ref)^0.5. Default: 3.0
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_CondLossPerNight_t: Base condition loss per night of use before Ah scaling is applied. Higher-Ah batteries lose less condition. Scaled by 1/(Ah/ref)^0.4. Default: 1.5
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_ConditionMin_toolt: Extended batteries will never degrade below this condition value. Set to 0 for no floor (batteries can fully degrade). Default: 0
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_EnableBulbs_toolti: When enabled, a lightbulb slot appears on the floodlight panel. A bulb must be inserted for the light to work. Different colored bulbs change the light color. Default: false
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_EnableRadiusBonus_: When enabled, higher-capacity batteries increase the light radius of the floodlight (up to +6 tiles).
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_ReferenceAh_toolti: The Ah capacity assigned to a standard Base.Battery. All scaling is relative to this value. Lower = car batteries feel more powerful. Default: 2.5
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_SensorPassiveDrain: Battery drain per hour when motion sensor is active but no motion detected. 0 = no passive drain. Default: 0
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_SensorRadius_toolt: Detection radius in tiles around the floodlight for the motion sensor. Default: 15
Sandbox_SLBatteryPack_SensorSkillLevel_t: Minimum Electrical skill level required to install a motion sensor. 0 = no skill needed. Default: 4
Sandbox_LowConPartsFall: Low durability parts have the chance to drop off cars
Sandbox_PartFallsWithParent: If the parent falls, so does the child. (If the tire pops off the hubcap will too)
Sandbox_HCO_BaseMuscleFatigueMult_toolti: Multiplies the amount of muscle stiffness gained per punch.
Sandbox_HCO_BasePunchDamageMult_tooltip: Multiplies the base damage of unarmed attacks.
Sandbox_HCO_BaseThrowDistanceMult_toolti: Multiplies the maximum distance a weapon can be thrown.
Sandbox_HCO_BaseThrowSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplies the speed at which the thrown weapon travels.
Sandbox_HCO_DualWieldAutoCombo_tooltip: If enabled, players automatically switch hands between attacks.
Sandbox_HCO_EnableFatigueDamagePenalty_t: If enabled, Hand condition affects overall damage.
Sandbox_HCO_EnableHandToHand_tooltip: If enabled, players can punch when unarmed.
Sandbox_HCO_EnableThrowDeviation_tooltip: If enabled, low Nimble skill and Panic can cause the weapon to miss the target.
Sandbox_HCO_EnableThrowables_tooltip: If enabled, players can throw specific melee weapons.
Sandbox_HCO_EnableUnarmedScratch_tooltip: If enabled, Punches without protection may have risks.
Sandbox_HCO_HCO_EnableDualGuns_tooltip: If enabled, Dual Guns(WIP!!!) may be tested by you(BEWARE!!).
Sandbox_HCO_RequireLeftArmModifier_toolt: If enabled, left punches require holding the Modifier Key.
Sandbox_CS2Firearms.replaceVanilla_toolt: Enable to remove vanilla firearms/attachments from the loot pool(mod attachments work on vanilla firearms)
Sandbox_SusceptibleCorpses_MaxCorpseAgeH: Max corpse age (hours) for infection risk
Sandbox_DeadMagic_LogLevel_tooltip: Controls non-critical Dead Magic logs. Errors always log.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_MagicTalentMagazineSpa: Magic Talent Magazine Spawn Rate Multiplier
Sandbox_EZRoof_RequireScaffold_tooltip: When enabled, placing ceilings requires a chair or stool as temporary scaffold.
Sandbox_BagBottomWeaponAttach_EnablePosi: Enable bottom attachment debug adjust UI
Allows right-clicking inventory items currently attached to bag-bottom slots to open a live offset/rotation adjustment window.
Sandbox_BagBottomWeaponAttach_EnableSmal: Enable small belt-type items on bag bottom
Allows belt-sized items such as knives, hammers, radios, and holstered sidearms to use bag-bottom attachment slots. These positions are generic and may need per-user adjustment with the debug UI.
Sandbox_PhunMart_AllowWalletDrop_tooltip: If enabled, players can drop currency from their wallet as a pickupable item. Intentional drops are always pickupable by any player, regardless of the wallet pickup setting.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToConvert_tooltip: The chance that a vanilla vending machine will get converted to a random PhunMart machine. Set to 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToDropChange: Chance for zombies to drop coins
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToDropChange_tool: The probability that a zombie will drop coins upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeCapCents_tooltip: Maximum cents a player can carry (9999 = $99.99). At cap, coins left on the ground will not be consumed.
Sandbox_PhunMart_Debug_tooltip: Adds more verbose logging for debugging purposes. Only use if you know what you're doing.
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultDistance_tooltip: The minimum distance between similarly grouped machines
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultHoursToRestock_t: The default number of hours between restocking a shop. 0 would mean that (by default) the shops are only ever stocked once
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultNumOfHoursToReRo: The default number of hours between changing the shop to a different one. 0 means shops will default to never changing
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultNumOfItemsWhenRe: Default number of items to stock
This the number of items a shop will stock by default
Sandbox_PhunMart_EditorRole_tooltip: If set, only players whose role name matches this value (case-insensitive) can open the editor. Leave empty to allow all players with access to debug/admin menu (or always allow in singleplayer).
Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableChangePool_toolti: Show the change (coin) currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableTokenPool_tooltip: Show the token currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The maximum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxStickyItems_tooltip: Maximum number of items allowed in a sticky pool before a warning is logged. Sticky pools always show all their items in a shop. Keep this low to avoid cluttered shops.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MinCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The minimum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_TokenCap_tooltip: Maximum number of special tokens a player can carry.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletDropOnDeath_toolt: If enabled, players will drop their wallet upon death
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnlyPickupOwn_too: If enabled, only the owner of a wallet can pick it up.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletReturnRate_toolti: The percentage of money that is returned to the player on death. 0 means no money is returned, 100 means all money is returned.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnableDebug: Enables the debug tuning options below. When this is off, the default values are used.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnableMinim: Turns the guaranteed weak fallback reflection on or off to soften dark gaps near walls.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnablePseud: Turn this off to disable the extra bounce light and compare against vanilla lighting.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_MinimumRefl: Sets how close to a wall the guaranteed weak reflection starts to appear. Smaller values mean you must be closer before the fallback begins.
Adjusts the guaranteed weak reflection used near walls to soften dark gaps during close-range rotation. 0.0 disables it. Higher values make the fallback much easier to notice.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionD: Sets how many tiles ahead a wall or closed door can still generate pseudo reflected light.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionS: Adjusts the pseudo reflected light brightness multiplier. 1.0 is the default strength.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionW: Adjusts how much weak lights shift the pseudo reflection toward a warmer color. 0.0 disables the warmth shift. 1.0 is the default, and higher values allow much stronger tinting.

Sandbox_DisablePagers_tooltip: Disables the Pager Configuration tab and all pager inventory options (Read Alerts, Volume, Date Format, Turn On/Off). Automatically disabled when Disable Computer System is on.
Sandbox_GeneratorHorizontalLinkRange_too: Horizontal distance used to link generators into the same shared power group. Set to 0 to use the vanilla generator sandbox range.
Sandbox_GeneratorVerticalLinkRange_toolt: Vertical floor distance used to link generators into the same shared power group. Set to 0 to use the vanilla generator sandbox height.
Sandbox_BetterWalkTo_EnableSounds_toolti: Whether Better Walk To may play click sounds when a valid Walk To destination is selected.
Sandbox_TacHold_AimingRequirement: Minimum Aiming Level for Long Guns
Sandbox_TacHold_AimingRequirement_toolti: Required aiming level before Long gun animations activate.
Sandbox_TacHold_PistolAimingRequirement_: Required aiming level before pistol animations activate.
Sandbox_JG_AllowDirectRecipeLearn_toolti: Allow players to learn a recipe directly from a Recipe Disk via the Print or Disk Viewer app, without spending paper to print the magazine.
Sandbox_JG_AllowQuestLiterature_tooltip: Whether the Book Scanner accepts tutorial / quest newspaper items. Off by default to avoid breaking single-character quest progression.
Sandbox_JG_BoredomReduction_tooltip: How much boredom decreases every 5 seconds while playing arcade games. 0 = disabled. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_ComponentLootWeight_tooltip: Multiplier for PC component loot spawn weights. Higher = more common. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskNegTraitChanceMult_to: Multiplier for the chance of receiving a negative trait from data disks.

Sandbox_JG_DataDiskRecipeEnabled_tooltip: Data disks can teach recipes on recovery.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskSpawnChance_tooltip: Multiplier for data disk spawn rates in loot tables. 1.0 = default, 0.5 = half, 2.0 = double.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskTraitEnabled_tooltip: Data disks can grant positive character traits on recovery.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskVirusChanceMult_toolt: Multiplier for the base virus chance on data disks. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskVirusDowntime_tooltip: How many real minutes a computer is disabled after a virus infection.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskVirusEnabled_tooltip: Data disks can contain viruses that disable the computer until repaired.
Sandbox_JG_DataDiskXPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier for XP recovered from data disks. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_JG_DiskReadMultiplierPct_tooltip: Percentage of the book's XP multiplier applied when reading from a library disk. 100 = identical to reading the physical book. Default: 100
Sandbox_JG_DiskReadSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier for reading time when studying a Skill Library Disk. Lower values = faster reading. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_EnableBookScanner_tooltip: Allow players to craft and use the Scanner peripheral to digitize skill books onto Skill Library Disks.
Sandbox_JG_EnableComponentLoot_tooltip: Allow PC components (video cards, RAM, soldering irons) to spawn in loot.
Sandbox_JG_EnableDataDisks_tooltip: Allow corrupted, damaged, and encrypted data disks to spawn in the world and be recovered at computers.
Sandbox_JG_EnableDiskViewer_tooltip: Allow players to launch the Disk Viewer app to browse and manage disk contents.
Sandbox_JG_EnableGameDisks_tooltip: Allow arcade game floppy disks (Breakout, Pong, Snake, etc.) to spawn in loot.
Sandbox_JG_EnableHacking_tooltip: Enable PDA hacking of vanilla PCs and security doors.
Sandbox_JG_EnableNotesApp_tooltip: Allow players to launch the Notes app to compose and save text documents to a Document Disk.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePDA_tooltip: Enable the Personal Digital Assistant feature. Disabling hides PDA items and context menu options.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePersonalDisks_tooltip: Allow players to record their skills onto blank floppy disks and recover them after death.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePrinter_tooltip: Allow players to craft and use the Printer peripheral. Disabling this hides print recipes and prevents the Print app from launching.
Sandbox_JG_EnableRecordedDiskJournalPrin: When JeevesJournals is also installed, allow the owner of a Recorded Disk to print it as a bound JeevesJournals journal. Owner-only; does not transfer XP between players.
Sandbox_JG_EnableTrainingDisks_tooltip: Allow skill training floppy disks to spawn in loot.
Sandbox_JG_GameDiskWeight_tooltip: Loot spawn weight for arcade game floppy disks. Higher = more common. Default: 0.5
Sandbox_JG_HackAlarmChance_tooltip: Chance that a failed security door hack triggers a zombie-attracting alarm. Default: 50
Sandbox_JG_HackAlarmRadius_tooltip: Radius in tiles that a door hack alarm attracts zombies. Default: 30
Sandbox_JG_HappinessMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier for happiness gained at score milestones while playing arcade games. 0 = disabled. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_MaxDocsPerDocumentDisk_toolti: Maximum number of notes / scanned documents stored on a single Document Disk. Default: 8
Sandbox_JG_MaxMagsPerRecipeDisk_tooltip: Maximum number of recipe magazines stored on a single Recipe Disk. Default: 10
Sandbox_JG_MaxNotesDocSize_tooltip: Maximum size in bytes for a single Notes app document. Default: 8192 (~8 KB)
Sandbox_JG_MaxSkillLevel_tooltip: Training disks stop granting XP once the player reaches this skill level. 0 = no limit. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_PDABatteryLife_tooltip: Real-time minutes a full PDA battery lasts while the UI is open in idle mode. Default: 120
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackMaxAttempts_tooltip: Maximum hack attempts allowed on each vanilla PC before it is exhausted. Shared across all players. Default: 3
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackResetDays_tooltip: In-game days before exhausted hack attempts reset on a vanilla PC. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackSuccessChance_tooltip: Base chance of a successful hack before skill and profession modifiers. Default: 25
Sandbox_JG_PDAReadTimePenalty_tooltip: Time multiplier when reading a Skill Library Disk on a PDA vs a PC. 1.0 = same speed, 2.0 = twice as long. Default: 1.5
Sandbox_JG_PDAZombieRadius_tooltip: Radius in tiles that PDA sounds attract nearby zombies. 0 = no attraction. Default: 15
Sandbox_JG_PaperReemSheets_tooltip: Number of paper sheets produced when opening a Ream of Paper. Default: 100
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskCombatSkills_tool: Override recovery percentage for melee combat skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskCraftingSkills_to: Override recovery percentage for crafting skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskDeductRadioTVXP_t: Subtract XP earned from radio/TV skill tapes before recording to personal disks.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskFarmingSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for farming and animal care skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskFirearmSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for firearm skills (Aiming, Reloading). -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskOneTimeUse_toolti: If enabled, each personal data disk can only be loaded once per character.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskPassiveSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for passive/physical skills. 0 = disabled by default.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverRecipes_to: Personal data disks also record and recover known recipes.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoveryPct_toolt: Percentage of recorded XP that can be recovered from personal data disks. 100 = full recovery.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskSurvivalistSkills: Override recovery percentage for survivalist skills (First Aid, Fishing, Foraging, Trapping, Tracking). -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PrintPaperCostMult_tooltip: Multiplier for the number of sheets consumed per print. Minimum 1 sheet enforced after scaling. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_PrintSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier for print timed-action duration. Higher values = faster prints. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_PrinterAttractsZombies_toolti: Whether the printer's page-feed sound triggers nearby zombie attention. Same audibility profile as the Book Scanner. Default: on
Sandbox_JG_PrinterCraftSkillReq_tooltip: Electrical skill level required to craft the Printer. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_ScanAwardsXP_tooltip: Whether scanning a book awards a small amount of Electrical XP to the scanning player.
Sandbox_JG_ScannerCraftSkillReq_tooltip: Electrical skill level required to craft the Scanner. Default: 4
Sandbox_JG_ScannerSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier for book scanning duration. Lower values = faster scans. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_Stage2XPBonus_tooltip: Extra lesson XP percentage for Stage 2 (Color) PCs. Default: 10
Sandbox_JG_Stage3XPBonus_tooltip: Extra lesson XP percentage for Stage 3 (Enhanced) PCs. Default: 20
Sandbox_JG_TrainingDiskWeight_tooltip: Loot spawn weight for skill training floppy disks. Higher = more common. Default: 0.3
Sandbox_JG_XP_Advanced_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Advanced (Tier III) training disk. Default: 300
Sandbox_JG_XP_Beginner_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Beginner (Tier I) training disk. Default: 75
Sandbox_JG_XP_Intermediate_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Intermediate (Tier II) training disk. Default: 150
Sandbox_JG_ZombieDataDiskDropMult_toolti: Multiplier for data disk drops from zombie corpses. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_Excrementum_ChymeMultiplier_tool: How much food leaves stomach in form of chyme every 10 ingame minutes.
Sandbox_Excrementum_ColonMinutes_tooltip: How much time must pass to start Colon Threshold moving down.
Sandbox_Excrementum_Shame_tooltip: How the shame is enabled (including multiplayer).
Sandbox_Excrementum_StomachVolume_toolti: The volume of stomach that keeps green moodle which restores health.
Sandbox_Excrementum_UnclogAnim_tooltip: Which animation plays when unclogging the toilet with the plunger.
Sandbox_Excrementum_VomitEnabled_tooltip: Enable or disable the automatic vomiting system.
Sandbox_GasMaskAttach_EnablePositionAdju: Enable gas mask attachment debug adjust UI
Allows right-clicking inventory items currently attached to gas mask hotbar slots to open a live offset and rotation adjustment window.
Sandbox_TooltipLib_EnableMPSync_tooltip: Allow the server to respond to tooltip data requests from clients. Disable to prevent any server-side tooltip processing.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBandageTre: Sets how many in-game hours a clean rag, sterilized rag, or bandage keeps adding healing after it is applied during rest.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseCarryW: Sets the default body carry limit for colony workers before bag weight reduction is applied. Higher values let scavengers haul more before returning home.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseWorkAm: Sets the total work required for a scavenger to finish one loot roll. Higher values make each scavenging roll take longer unless the worker has better speed multipliers.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseWorkMu: Sets the base scavenging speed multiplier before archetype bonuses and equipment bonuses are applied. Higher values make scavengers complete work faster.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDailyCalor: Sets the fixed daily hunger reserve consumed by colony workers. This value is also used as the hunger bar's full-day target.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDailyHydra: Sets the fixed daily hydration reserve consumed by colony workers. This value is also used as the hydration bar's full-day target.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDoctorHeal: Scales resting HP recovery when doctor treatment hours are available for the worker.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyFishingWor: Sets the total work required for a fishing worker to finish one catch roll. Higher values make each catch take longer unless the worker has better speed multipliers or active bait.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyHealthRege: Labour: Home Health Regen Per Hour
Sets how much HP a resting worker naturally recovers per in-game hour before infirmary and doctor bonuses are applied.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyInfirmaryH: Scales resting HP recovery for workers assigned to an infirmary bed.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyScavengeTr: How many in-game hours a scavenger spends traveling to or from the assigned scavenging site.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.CompanionCommand: How many tiles away a commanded Travel Companion can be and still answer a radial command.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.StarterWorkerCou: How many generated starter workers each player receives once. Multiplayer players each get their own grant before joining another colony faction.
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_AllowRoomOnlyClaim: Allow claims with only non-residential rooms (no residential building)
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles: Block street/highway floor tiles in safehouse selections
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_DrawAreaStreetBufferT: Allowed distance for street tiles around draw-area claim
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_MinSurvivedDays: Min. survived days to claim a safehouse
Sandbox_NailGunMod_RecoveryChance_toolti: Determines the percentage chance for a zombie to drop a nail when hit by the Nail Gun.
Sandbox_NailGunMod_SpawnRate_tooltip: Determines how often the Nail Gun spawns in the world.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_AllowOpenClose_to: Whether standpipes can be opened and closed with a pipe wrench.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_AllowWaterSource_: Whether opened standpipes become a dynamic water source.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BaseDuration_tool: How many seconds the action takes for a character with Strength 0.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BaseMuscleStrain_: How much muscle strain the action adds for a character with Strength 0.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BlowTorchUseCost_: How many Blow Torch uses are consumed when building the city standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_EnableSounds_tool: Whether the mod hydrant interaction sounds are enabled.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalBarAmount_to: How many Metal Bars are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalPipeAmount_t: How many Metal Pipes are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalWeldingSkill: Required Metal Welding skill to build the city standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MinimumStrength_t: A character must have at least this Strength level to open or close a standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_ScrapMetalAmount_: How many Scrap Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_SheetMetalAmount_: How many Sheet Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_SmallSheetMetalAm: How many Small Sheet Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_TirePumpAmount_to: How many Tire Pumps are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_WeldingRodsUseCos: How many Welding Rod uses are consumed when building the city standpipe.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AffectAnimals_toolti: If enabled, living animals will take damage during toxic days.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AffectZombies_toolti: If enabled, living zombies will take damage during toxic days.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AntiCopyrightPremoni: Designed for streamers and content creators. Replaces the original song with a cover track to avoid copyright issues.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_ClothingSelection_to: Applies a recommended spawn chance for protective suits and masks from this mod.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_CycleDurationDays_to: Total in-game days the toxic system remains active. (0 for infinite).
Sandbox_ElEternauta_DelayStartDays_toolt: Number of in-game days before the first toxic event can start. (0 for immediate start).
Sandbox_ElEternauta_DisableGearWear_tool: If enabled, masks, suits, and protected gear will not lose durability from this mod's wear system.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_EnableToxicEvents_to: If enabled, the mod will run alternating toxic-day and safe-day cycles.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_GearWearIntensity_to: Adjusts gear wear from usage. 5 = current default. 0 = much slower wear. 10 = faster wear.
Sandbox_AdminAuthoritativeControl_toolti: When ON, only logged-in admins can change CSR sandbox options at runtime via the in-game settings panel. Recommended for public servers. Default OFF (any sandbox-allowed user can adjust).
Sandbox_AllowHumanHarvest: Allow Field Dress on Human Bodies
Sandbox_AllowHumanHarvest_tooltip: If ON, dead player corpses can also be field-dressed into human flesh. Causes stress and unhappiness when performed and again when eaten. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_AntibodyDecayPerHour_tooltip: How quickly temporary antibody response fades when not infected. Permanent immunity progress does not decay. Default: 12.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawCooldownHours_toolti: How many in-game hours an immune donor must wait between blood draws. Default: 24.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawHealthCost_tooltip: Overall health removed from the immune donor when a sample is collected. Default: 4.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawMinHealth_tooltip: Minimum overall health required before a donor can provide immune blood. Default: 35.
Sandbox_AntibodyGrowthPerHour_tooltip: How quickly antibody response grows while truly infected. Health, wounds, care, and serum can raise or lower the effective rate. Default: 18.
Sandbox_AntibodyImmunityRollBonusPerPoin: Antibodies - roll bonus per immunity point
Extra survival-roll chance gained per permanent immunity point before full immunity. Default: 0.25.
Sandbox_AntibodyImmunityThreshold_toolti: Permanent immunity value at which future true infections are neutralized automatically. Default: 100.
Sandbox_AntibodyRollBonusPerPoint: Antibodies - roll bonus per response point
Sandbox_AntibodyRollBonusPerPoint_toolti: Extra survival-roll chance gained per current antibody response point. Default: 0.20.
Sandbox_AntibodySampleShelfHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours an immune blood syringe remains viable. Default: 72.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours an injected serum boost lasts. Default: 8.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumImmediateBoost_tool: Instant antibody response added when serum is injected. Default: 8.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumPower_tooltip: Survival-roll bonus granted by immune blood serum before First Aid scaling. Default: 15.
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGainPerPart: Antibodies - extra gain per infected part
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGainPerPart_tool: Extra permanent immunity gained for each infected body part when the player survives. Default: 5.
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGain_tooltip: Base permanent immunity gained after surviving a true Knox infection. Default: 25.
Sandbox_BathingClearsMuscleStrain_toolti: A finished bath removes all accumulated muscle strain (stiffness) on every body part.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffBackpack_tooltip: Auto-unequip backpacks and fanny packs before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffClothes_tooltip: Auto-unequip jackets, shirts, pants, shoes, etc. before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffHeadwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip hats, masks, and eyewear before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffUnderwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip undergarments before entering the tub. Off by default.
Sandbox_BathingWaterCost_tooltip: Liters of water drained from the tub per bath. Set to 0 for free bathing. Default 40.
Sandbox_BatteryLifeMultiplier_tooltip: How many times longer supported battery-powered light sources last. 1 = vanilla drain, 5 = default, values above 10 are accepted for old server configs but capped to 10.
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction: Bink's Scooper: max scoops per action
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction_tooltip: Cap on how many dung items a single scoop action can clear. Higher values let one click clean a denser farm yard but cost more time. Range 10-60. Default 30.
Sandbox_BinksScooperRadius_tooltip: Radius around the player searched for dung when using the scoop option. Range 1-6. Default 3.
Sandbox_BoltCutSuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales bolt cutter success chance. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationDamageScale_too: Multiplier for penetration damage. 0.4 = penetrating bullets deal 40% of the original damage to the next zombie.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationMaxTargets_tool: Maximum number of additional zombies a bullet can hit after the primary target.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationMode_tooltip: Kill Only: bullets only penetrate when the initial hit kills the zombie. Non-Lethal: bullets can penetrate on any hit above a damage threshold.
Sandbox_CabinFilterHeaterBoost_tooltip: Additional multiplier applied when the vehicle heater is running. Lower values mean stronger filtering with a heater on.
Sandbox_CabinFilterStrength_tooltip: Maximum reduction applied when the cabin is fully sealed. 0 disables. 1 fully blocks corpse sickness gain in a perfect cabin.
Sandbox_CanInjuryChance_tooltip: Chance of a cut when opening cans with a knife. 0.0 = disabled.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseDuration_toolti: Base timed action duration in ticks for operating a standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseMuscleStrain_to: Base muscle strain applied when operating a standpipe. Higher values increase fatigue.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeMinimumStrength_too: Minimum Strength level required to operate a fire hydrant standpipe.
Sandbox_ClaimAdminsInvisible: Admins do not appear on members list
