Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_AnimalBarbedFenc: Prevents vanilla animals from destroying barbed wire fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_BarbedFenceInter: Allows special interactions with barbed wire fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_BetterWashMenu_t: Adds wash categories for all, equipped, unequipped and weapons.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_BuildingRadialMe: Enables the mod radial menu for doors, windows, curtains, barricades and fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarDoorPry_t: Allows crowbars to pry locked doors.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarWindowPry: Allows crowbars to pry locked windows.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceBareHands_t: Allows dangerous bare-hand fence interactions when supported.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceBlowTorch_t: Allows blowtorch and welding mask actions on metal fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceBoltCutters: Allows bolt cutters to cut or open passages in supported fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceHoe_tooltip: Allows hoe actions on supported fences and structures.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceInjuryEffec: Enables damage, scratches, blood and sounds when a player is hurt by dangerous fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceMaterialRet: Enables material returns when dismantling fences, such as wire, metal pipes, barbed wire, wood and scrap.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FencePickAxe_too: Allows pickaxe actions on supported fences and structures.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceRadialMenu_: Enables radial options to cut, open passages or dismantle fences.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceShovel_tool: Allows shovel actions on supported fences and structures.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_FenceXPRewards_t: Enables Metalworking, Carpentry or Mechanics XP rewards depending on the action.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_PhysicalActionCo: Enables endurance, pain and fatigue costs for physical mod actions.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_PryingMechanic_t: Master control for crowbar pry actions on doors, windows and barricades.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialBarricades: Allows adding and removing barricades from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialBreakWindo: Allows breaking windows from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialClimbWindo: Allows climbing through windows from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialCurtains_t: Allows opening, closing, removing and adding sheet curtains from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialDoorWindow: Allows opening and closing doors and windows from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_RadialRemoveGlas: Allows removing broken glass from the mod radial menu.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_SceneCollecting_: Allows collecting visible twigs, stones, trash, planks and papers from the world.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_ToolWear_tooltip: Enables crowbar, bolt cutter, shovel, pickaxe and hoe wear from mod actions.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_VehicleDoorPryin: Allows crowbars to pry vehicle doors.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_VehicleLockRepai: Allows vehicle lock repair options to appear.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_VehiclePrying_to: Master control for vehicle mechanics added by the mod.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_VehicleWeldedLoc: Allows repairing vehicle locks with blowtorch, welding mask and materials.
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t: Per-container chance that a filled military tent pack appears in eligible military or ranger/camping containers. 0 disables loot spawns entirely. Default: 10.
Sandbox_Anomaliesb42_EnableFrostZone_too: If disabled, the mod will not generate new Frost Zones. Existing zones will dissipate over time.
Sandbox_Anomaliesb42_EnableThermalZone_t: If disabled, the mod will not generate new Thermal Zones (fire). Existing zones will dissipate over time.
Sandbox_Anomaliesb42_EnableToxicZone_too: If disabled, the mod will not generate new Toxic Zones. Existing zones will dissipate over time.
Sandbox_ZT_Aggression_tooltip: Multiplier on horde sizes the brain is allowed to request.
Sandbox_ZT_AllowAtmospheric_tooltip: When off, the Director skips non-spawn flavor: ambient sounds, phantom gunshots, radio static, and meta-event nudges (helicopter/distant gunfire).
Sandbox_ZT_AllowCulling_tooltip: Lets the tactician remove far-off, off-screen, non-combatant zombies to free up spawn capacity. Never affects zombies near the player or in line of sight.
Sandbox_ZT_AllowLures_tooltip: When off, the Director will not lure existing zombies or redirect them toward players (lure_existing / redirect_zombies). No new zombies are involved either way.
Sandbox_ZT_AllowRuntimeSpawns_tooltip: When off, the Director never spawns hordes or runs sieges (spawn_horde / siege_phase). Use this on dedicated servers if runtime-spawned zombies cause sync glitches. Taunts, lures, atmospherics and weather still work.
Sandbox_ZT_AllowWeatherControl_tooltip: Lets the cognitive brain trigger weather events. Manual Control panel works regardless of this setting.
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip: Server-only. WARNING: sandbox values replicate to all clients in MP. Whitelist-only servers only.
Sandbox_ZT_BrainMode_tooltip: Cognitive: full 18-module brain with Bayesian beliefs, goals, mood, bandit learning. Deterministic: legacy single-rule brain (fallback if cognitive misbehaves).
Sandbox_ZT_CycleSeconds_tooltip: Real-time seconds between Director decisions. Range 10-3600 (10s to 1 hour). Lower than 30 on Cognitive may cause plan churn; higher values (300+) give long peaceful stretches between events — pair with base-building runs.
Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip: Hard limit on brain calls per real-world day. 0 disables the cap.
Sandbox_ZT_DashboardEnabled_tooltip: Writes a JSON snapshot of the brain to Zomboid/Lua/ZT_brain.json every 5 seconds, for the optional web dashboard.
Sandbox_ZT_DebugTeleportToSpawn_tooltip: When the Director spawns a horde, automatically teleport you to the spawn point. For testing only — disable for normal play.
Sandbox_ZT_DryRun_tooltip: Log every action the brain picks but do NOT execute it. Use to verify the director is making reasonable decisions before letting it loose.
Sandbox_ZT_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. Off = director never ticks.
Sandbox_ZT_Model_tooltip: Default Sonnet. Haiku is cheapest, Opus is smartest.
Sandbox_ZT_MonologueRate_tooltip: How often the inner voice speaks. Sparse = only big moments, Chatty = ambient musings welcome.
Sandbox_ZT_VisualDebug_tooltip: Outline Director-spawned zombies in cyan and show a brief on-screen toast each time the Director acts. For testing only.
Sandbox_ZT_VoiceMode_tooltip: Off = silent. Director = the original menacing taunts. Monologue = your character thinks out loud, voice-flavored by their PZ traits + profession. Mutually exclusive.
Sandbox_ZT_VoiceProfile_tooltip: Force a specific monologue voice or let it be picked from your character's traits + profession. Auto picks once per character; force overrides without changing the cache.
Sandbox_EnableLightSwitchFinder_tooltip: When ON, dark rooms automatically outline nearby light switches in purple so they are easier to find. Players can toggle their local view with the LS button on the Utility HUD. Default ON.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_BaseHealingAmount_t: Health amount recovered per hour for players and NPCs in a base with a doctor. This stacks with the number of doctors, and nurses add an extra bonus per nurse.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_BaseRadiusLarge_too: Radius in tiles for a large base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_BaseRadiusMedium_to: Radius in tiles for a medium base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_BaseRadiusSmall_too: Radius in tiles for a small base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_BaseStructureRepair: Health restored to each damaged door, window, or barricade per repair interval. This stacks with the number of repairmen assigned to the base.

Sandbox_WDecay_generalConditionChance_to: Chance per part that the general condition is applied.

Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool: Minimum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxDamageChance_tool: Chance that the glove box is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxMissingChance_too: Chance the glove box is missing.
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentageOnRoad_too: How much vanilla grass spawns on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentage_tooltip: How much vanilla grass spawns on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentageOnR: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentage_to: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_headlightDamageChance_too: Chance that a headlight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_heaterDamageChance_toolti: Chance that the heater is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_hoodDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the hood is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorBushesPercentage_to: How many bushes spawn inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorGrassPercentage_too: How much grass and overgrowth spawns inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_multiFloorVines_tooltip: If enabled, vines also grow on upper floor walls. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_priorityRadius_tooltip: Chunks within this distance from the player are processed first with high priority.
Sandbox_WDecay_radioDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the radio is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadCrackOverlayPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofCustomGrassPercentage: How much custom grass and debris spawns on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_roofGrassPercentage_toolt: How much vanilla grass spawns on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_roofPercentage_tooltip: How many roofs on upper floors are destroyed, with 80% chance of replacing with a destroyed variant.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanInterval_tooltip: How often the mod scans for new chunks around the player. Lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage. In Multiplayer, this value is automatically doubled.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanRadius_tooltip: How many chunks away from the player are scanned for processing. Higher = more area covered but more chunks queued at once.
Sandbox_WDecay_taillightDamageChance_too: Chance that a taillight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeBudgetMs_tooltip: Maximum milliseconds per frame for world generation. Lower = smoother FPS but slower generation. Higher = faster generation but possible lag spikes.
Sandbox_WDecay_tireDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that a tire is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentageOnRoad_too: How much decorative trash appears on roads and streets.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentage_tooltip: How much decorative trash (non-lootable) scatters on the ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentageOnRoad_tool: How many trees spawn on roads and pavement.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentage_tooltip: How many trees with random foliage spawn on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_trunkDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the trunk is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip: Maximum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip: Minimum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt: Master switch. Disable to prevent any vehicle deterioration from this mod.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRarity_tooltip: How often abandoned, rusted vehicles with blood stains spawn on roads.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip: Maximum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip: Minimum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinePercentage_tooltip: How much ivy and vines grow on exterior walls and fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesExteriorOnly_tooltip: If enabled, vines only grow on exterior squares. Disable to allow vines inside buildings. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnFences_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on fences and railings. Disable to prevent vines on fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnWalls_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on exterior walls. Disable to prevent vines on building walls.
Sandbox_WDecay_wallPercentage_tooltip: How many exterior wooden walls are replaced with burnt/damaged variants. Excludes doors and windows.
Sandbox_WDecay_windowDamageChance_toolti: Chance that a window is damaged.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_BodyWeightDifficu: Controls how strongly character weight affects difficulty. 0 ignores weight, 1 is default, higher values punish heavy characters more.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_EnduranceCostMult: Controls endurance consumed by each doorway pull-up. 0 disables endurance cost.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_FitnessXPMultipli: Additional multiplier for Fitness XP only.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_MaxTrainUntilTire: Maximum reps that Train Until Tired can queue from one action.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_RegularityDecayPe: How many regularity points are lost per day after 24 in-game hours without training.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_RegularityGainMul: Controls how quickly the doorway pull-up regularity bar improves.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_RepTimeMultiplier: Controls how long each doorway pull-up takes. 1.0 is default, lower is faster, higher is slower.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_SorenessMultiplie: Controls arm and back muscle strain caused by doorway pull-ups. 0 disables added soreness.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_StrengthXPMultipl: Additional multiplier for Strength XP only.
Sandbox_DoorwayPullUps_XPMultiplier_tool: Applies to both Fitness and Strength XP from doorway pull-ups.
Sandbox_EHR_AHTREnabled_tooltip: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction from incompatible blood transfusions. Dangerous and potentially lethal.
Sandbox_EHR_AllowFullPharmacyPackages_to: Allows pharmacies and drugstores to occasionally spawn full medication packages. Other locations are still capped below full.
Sandbox_EHR_CadavericAspergillosisEnable: Fungal lung infection from decaying corpses in damp, rainy, wet or cold conditions. Progressive respiratory failure.
Sandbox_EHR_CellulitisEnabled_tooltip: Skin infection from poor wound closure or untreated wound spread. Can progress to sepsis if not treated.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdChanceMultiplier_t: Scales the final common cold contraction roll after exposure is ready. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdExposureMultiplier: Scales how quickly cold/wet exposure accumulates before common cold rolls. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionEnabled_tooltip: Head trauma from serious falls and vehicle crashes. Causes headache, nausea, dizziness, and temporary impairment.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionFallChanceMultipli: Scales concussion rolls from serious height falls after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionVehicleChanceMulti: Scales concussion rolls from severe vehicle crashes after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CorpseSicknessEnabled_toolti: Acute sickness from corpse putrefaction gases. This controls ordinary corpse exposure illness; cadaveric aspergillosis has its own toggle.
Sandbox_EHR_DeliriumEnabled_tooltip: Mental breakdown from prolonged maximum stress. Causes hallucinations, intrusive actions, and disturbing audio events until treated.
Sandbox_EHR_DysenteryChanceMultiplier_to: Scales dysentery rolls from tainted water, toilets, rivers, lakes, and rain collectors. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_FoodPoisoningChanceMultiplie: Scales food poisoning rolls from rotten, burned, stale, dangerous uncooked, and unsafe uncooked food. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_GastroenteritisChanceMultipl: Scales gastroenteritis rolls from dirty or bloody hands. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureGainMultiplier_t: Scales how quickly heat exposure builds up once the temperature threshold is met. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureHoursToFull_tool: How many in-game hours of baseline heat exposure are needed to fill the heat exposure bar. <LINE> Default: 4 hours.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureRecoveryMultipli: Scales how quickly heat exposure drains indoors or below the heat threshold. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatExposureTemperatureThres: World or vehicle-inside temperature where heat exposure starts accumulating. <LINE> Default: 30C.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatHeadwearExposureMultipli: Multiplier applied to heat exposure buildup while wearing headwear. <LINE> Lower means stronger protection. <LINE> Default: 0.30.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatStrokeChanceMultiplier_t: Scales heat stroke contraction/progression rolls from heat exposure. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_HeatStrokeEnabled_tooltip: Lethal heat illness caused by untreated heat exposure. Disables heat stroke contraction while keeping heat exhaustion available.
Sandbox_EHR_HouseholdPrescriptionLoot_to: Allows rare prescription medication leftovers to spawn in houses, bedrooms, desks, and similar non-medical locations.
Sandbox_EHR_HyperkeratoticScabiesEnabled: Severe parasitic skin infestation from prolonged contact with dirt or grass. Causes itching, fever, wounds, and can become lethal.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaClearTemp_tooltip: Core temperature required to clear temperature-driven hypothermia. <LINE> Default: 35.5C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage1Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 1. <LINE> Default: 35C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage2Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 2. <LINE> Default: 34C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage3Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 3. <LINE> Default: 32C.
Sandbox_EHR_HypothermiaStage4Temp_toolti: Core temperature threshold for hypothermia stage 4. <LINE> Default: 31C.
Sandbox_EHR_InsomniaEnabled_tooltip: Sleep disorder from prolonged exhaustion or stimulant crashes. Severe insomnia prevents sleep until treated.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicalWatchLootMultiplier_t: Scales Medical Monitor Watch spawn chance copied from vanilla red digital watches. <LINE> <LINE> 0.0 = disabled, 0.35 = rare, 1.0 = vanilla watch rate.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicalWatchRequired_tooltip: When enabled, the EHR blood volume bar requires a Medical Monitor Watch. Disable to always show blood data.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicationLootMultiplier_too: Scales EHR medication and medical supply spawn chances. <LINE> <LINE> 0.0 = disabled, 0.5 = half, 1.0 = default, 2.0 = double.
Sandbox_EHR_MedicationPackageFill_toolti: Controls how many doses remain inside spawned multi-dose medication packages.
Sandbox_EHR_PatientZeroTraitDisabled_too: When enabled, Patient Zero is hidden during character creation and Gene Therapy only cures the current Knox infection without granting permanent Knox immunity.
Sandbox_EHR_RealisticTemperatureCompatib: Controls how EHR behaves when Realistic Temperature is installed. <LINE> Auto/Enabled keep Realistic Temperature indoor simulation active, but disable its body-temperature system so EHR controls fever, hypothermia, cold, and sickness. Disabled leaves Realistic Temperature untouched.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesChanceMultiplier_tool: Scales the scabies roll while sitting on natural ground. <LINE> 1.0 = current 3% check every 15 in-game minutes.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesSnowBlock_tooltip: When enabled, scabies ground exposure cannot trigger on snow-covered tiles or during active snow cover.
Sandbox_EHR_ScabiesWinterBlock_tooltip: When enabled, scabies ground exposure cannot trigger in December, January, or February.
Sandbox_EHR_StitchMinigameEnabled_toolti: When enabled, stitching deep wounds opens a short EHR suturing minigame before the vanilla stitch action. Disable for vanilla stitching.
Sandbox_EHR_TetanusChanceMultiplier_tool: Scales tetanus contraction rolls from deep wounds with glass. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance. <LINE> 0.5 = half chance. <LINE> 0 = disabled chance without hiding the disease.
Sandbox_EHR_TheLastPrescriptionEnabled_t: Adds The Last Prescription on 47.0 MHz. Morning broadcasts grant small First Aid XP; evening broadcasts can unlock disease knowledge if heard.
Sandbox_EHR_ToxinPoisoningEnabled_toolti: Dangerous poisoning from toxic mushrooms and berries. Can be lethal without fast treatment.
Sandbox_EHR_TrichinosisChanceMultiplier_: Scales trichinosis rolls from raw or undercooked wild game meat. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_BypassUtilitiesRequi: If enabled, event scheduling can run before utility shutdown.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_DisableFilterBleedTh: Disables monolith age/strength bleed-through against gas mask filter protection.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_DisableMonolithSprin: Forces monolith threshold-25 wave zombies to spawn as normal shamblers.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or disables the TSA anomaly event scheduler.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_MaxActiveMonoliths_t: Maximum number of active managed anomaly zones.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_RegionDefaultEdgeIns: Default inward trim (tiles) applied to region bounds.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_RegionFallbackEnable: If enabled, scheduler falls back to legacy global spawn attempts.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_RegionLayerEnabled_t: Uses TSA town-region candidate selection before global fallback.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_RewardBonusDropCount: Maximum extra reward items added from core age scaling.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_RewardDropCount_tool: Base number of reward items dropped when a core is destroyed.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_TriggerChancePercent: Chance that an event attempt succeeds when rolled.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_UseSandboxOverrides_: OFF: use Mod Options/saved config. ON: use TSAnomalies sandbox values as authoritative.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_WaveSize25_tooltip: Number of zombies spawned when a core reaches the 25% threshold.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_WaveSize50_tooltip: Number of zombies spawned when a core reaches the 50% threshold.
Sandbox_TSAnomalies_WaveSize75_tooltip: Number of zombies spawned when a core reaches the 75% threshold.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelDefaultCap: Maximum liquid units for newly initialized barrels. Existing barrels keep their saved capacity.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelEmptyWeigh: Base weight used for empty barrels and carried barrel items.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightBle: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain bleach. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightEmp: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to be empty. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightGas: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain gasoline. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightTai: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain tainted water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightWat: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain clean water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_IndustrialWeight: Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MaxInteractionDi: Maximum distance, in tiles, for barrel interactions.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightBl: Relative chance for military barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightEm: Relative chance for military barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightGa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightTa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightWa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_OpenBarrelRequir: Full item types, separated by commas or semicolons, that can open sealed barrels. Invalid or empty lists fall back to the default tools.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireFunnelToP: If enabled, players need a funnel to pour liquids into barrels.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireHoseToExt: If enabled, players need a rubber hose to fill containers from barrels.
Sandbox_PFC_AutoOpenEngineBayWithMechani: Open The Shop with vanilla mechanics
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MaxPartsDr: Maximum number of installed parts that can be recovered.\n-1 means no limit. Zero disables part recovery entirely.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinMechani: Minimum Mechanics skill level required to salvage a vehicle. Zero means no requirement.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinPartsDr: Minimum number of installed parts guaranteed to be recovered.\n-1 means maximum eligible parts are always recovered.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinWelding: Minimum Metal Welding skill level required to salvage a vehicle. Zero means no requirement.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_SalvageDur: Multiplier applied to the base burnt vehicle removal time when salvaging a normal vehicle.
Sandbox_BGD_SandboxOptions_MaxSize: Maximum allowed garage door size, in tiles
Sandbox_BGD_SandboxOptions_MaxSize_toolt:
Set the maximum allowed size for garage doors

Example:
3 mean only 3-tiles doors are allowed (left, middle, right)
4 mean 3-tiles and 4-tiles are allowed (left, middle, right) and (left, middle, middle, right)
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableBrandenburg: Enables or disables radiation between Brandenburg and Irvington.
Enables or disables radiation in Brandenburg.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableEchoCreek_t: Enables or disables radiation in Echo Creek.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableLouisville_: Enables or disables radiation in Louisville.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableRiverside_t: Enables or disables radiation in Riverside.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableRosewood_to: Enables or disables radiation in Rosewood.
Sandbox_MailboxStories_EnableLetters_too: Adds readable letters, cards, notes, paperwork, and tickets to mailbox tiles supported by Mailbox Stories.
Sandbox_MailboxStories_EnableParcels_too: Adds mail bags and parcel containers to supported mailbox tiles, then fills parcels with themed loot by item display category.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecallKnox_FloorPercent_t: Fraction of vanilla XP kept when skipping/failing.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecallKnox_TestFormat_too: Choose whether minigame volumes stay as minigames or become written quizzes.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecallKnox_XPBonusMultipl: When XP Mode is Bonus, 90%+ gives vanilla XP * this. Range 1.0 to 2.0.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecallKnox_XPMode_tooltip: How XP is rewarded based on test score.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecall_FloorPercent_toolt: Fraction of vanilla XP kept when skipping/failing. 0.0 = no reward, 1.0 = full reward.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecall_TestFormat_tooltip: Choose whether minigame volumes stay as minigames or become written quizzes.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecall_XPBonusMultiplier_: When XP Mode is Bonus, 90%+ gives vanilla XP * this. Range 1.0 to 2.0.
Sandbox_ReadAndRecall_XPMode_tooltip: How XP is rewarded based on test score.
Sandbox_BVD_Drag_tooltip: Aerodynamic resistance scaling. Higher caps top speed sooner and bleeds momentum faster.
Sandbox_BVD_DriftGrip_tooltip: Tire grip kept while drifting. Lower is looser and harder to hold.
Sandbox_BVD_DriftMinSpeed_tooltip: Below this speed the drift key is ignored, so parking doesn't slide.
Sandbox_BVD_DriftRotation_tooltip: Strength of the rotation pushed into the car while drifting + steering. Raise if it slides wide, lower if it spins out.
Sandbox_BVD_DriftSteer_tooltip: How much sharper the front wheels respond while a drift is held.
Sandbox_BVD_Drift_tooltip: Hold the drift key while cornering at speed to break the rear loose for an arcade-style slide. Bind the key in Mod Options.
Sandbox_BVD_DriverHUD_tooltip: Adds a Better Vehicle Dynamics panel docked beside the vehicle mechanics window, showing the active tuning profile and grip settings (the values vanilla does not display).
Sandbox_BVD_EnginePower_tooltip: Scales how much pulling force every engine makes. Below 1 feels gutless; above 1 makes hills and ramming trivial.
Sandbox_BVD_GripLevel_tooltip: Overall traction budget. Lower means the car steps out and spins up more readily.
Sandbox_BVD_KeylessTow_tooltip: When off, easy-tow needs keys in the ignition or the parking brake released.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadAffectsFuel_tooltip: Carrying a heavy load burns extra fuel while driving.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadAffectsHandling_tooltip: A heavily loaded vehicle is slow to pull away from a stop, as if the engine is straining against the weight.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadMaxPenalty: Max launch penalty when fully loaded
Sandbox_BVD_LoadMaxPenalty_tooltip: Biggest drop in launch force for a fully loaded vehicle (0.50 = up to 50% less force from a stop). Fades out as the vehicle speeds up. Requires 'Load affects handling'.
Sandbox_BVD_LowSpeedGrunt_tooltip: Extra pulling force available at very low wheel speed — the force used to push wrecks and shove through crowds. Lower it for a weaker, more cautious low-end.
Sandbox_BVD_Mode_tooltip: Custom keeps every slider below as you set it. The other presets snap drivetrain, grip and shove values to a curated profile when the world loads.
Sandbox_BVD_OffroadFloor_tooltip: Minimum off-road grip multiplier any tire family can fall to. Without this, sports-tire profiles can drop off-road grip so low a high-HP car barely moves on grass. Default 0.55 keeps brute-force motion possible (the car will slip and chew tires, but it moves).
Sandbox_BVD_OffroadGrip_tooltip: Off-road grip strength. HIGHER = more grip (less tire slip) on dirt, grass and gravel. Default 0.85 = moderate slip; 1.5 = near-paved feel. Does not change rolling drag - tune that via Rolling drag off-road.
Sandbox_BVD_RealismHPWeight_tooltip: Replaces engine force and mass for the covered vanilla vehicles with Better Vehicle Dynamics' own researched reference figures (see BVD_VehicleData.lua; modded vehicles can register their own via the public API).
Sandbox_BVD_RollResistanceOffroad_toolti: Extra rolling resistance when off sealed road.
Sandbox_BVD_RollResistance_tooltip: Resistance from tires on sealed surfaces. Affects coasting and steady-state speed.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveCorpses_tooltip: Force imparted to bodies and gibs on the ground.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveFoliage_tooltip: Force the body transfers into bushes and small plants on contact.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveZombies_tooltip: Force imparted to living zombies struck by the vehicle.
Sandbox_BVD_SkidMarks_tooltip: Leaves a ground decal when a tire breaks loose under power or hard braking.
Sandbox_BVD_SkidSound_tooltip: Plays a tire-screech sound when a vehicle is sliding. Independent of the tire-marks visual. Disable if the sound is bothering you or if a sound mod conflicts.
Sandbox_BVD_SnowGrip_tooltip: Fraction of normal grip on snow-covered ground.
Sandbox_BVD_StabilityGuardSinkTiles_tool: How far below its own level's floor a vehicle must sink before the guard re-seats it, measured in floor levels (0.75 = three-quarters of one level). Lower reacts sooner; raise it if a custom map ever triggers it wrongly. Requires 'Vehicle ground-clip guard'.
Sandbox_BVD_StabilityGuard_tooltip: Safety net for multiplayer: if a vehicle sinks far below the floor of the level it is on (the 'sucked into the ground' desync), it is snapped back onto that floor. Only acts on a state that is never reached by normal driving, so ramps, basements and multi-level parking are unaffected.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringCenteringHighSpeed_t: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels return to center at high speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringCenteringLowSpeed_to: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels return to center at low speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringFactorHighSpeed_tool: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn at high speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringFactorLowSpeed_toolt: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn at low speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringHighSpeed_tooltip: Speed (km/h) at which steering uses the high-speed response and centering values instead of the low-speed ones.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringSnapback_tooltip: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn while a drift is held.
Sandbox_BVD_ThrottleStart_tooltip: When off, the engine must be started deliberately (start key or the engine icon) rather than by pressing accelerate.
Sandbox_BVD_TireGripModel_tooltip: Different tire types (worn / standard / modern) get distinct grip on road, rain, snow and off-road instead of one flat value.
Sandbox_BVD_TireSlipWearRate_tooltip: Multiplier on how fast tires degrade while slipping. 1.0 is the default (a few minutes of hard slipping noticeably degrades them). Set to 0 to disable wear without disabling the model.
Sandbox_BVD_TireSlipWear_tooltip: When the engine is forcing the wheels faster than the surface can grip (e.g. flooring it on grass) tires lose condition over time. Lets you brute-force through low-grip surfaces - at the cost of bald tires later.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkCar_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkScaling_tooltip: Scales each vehicle's storage by a per-body-type factor instead of overwriting it. Auto-disabled when 'isoContainers' is present.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkTrailer_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkTruck_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkVan_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_WetGrip_tooltip: Fraction of normal grip while it is raining.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_ArcChancePercent_tool: Percent chance per broadcast to play the next available serial arc episode. 0 disables arc picks but keeps standalone broadcasts.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_ArcEnabled_tooltip: Allows ordered multi-part voices such as Dispatch, Bookman, Mapmaker, Hollow Choir, and Field Logs.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_AvoidRepeatWindow_too: How many recent broadcasts the station tries not to repeat. 0 disables this protection.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_Debug_tooltip: Writes extra Aftermath Radio details to the game logs. Use mainly for testing.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_Enabled_tooltip: Turns Aftermath Radio broadcasts on or off.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_Frequency_tooltip: Radio frequency as MHz x 1000. Default 101800 means 101.8 MHz.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_InventoryRadioEffects: Off by default. When off, a radio inside the backpack does not give XP or mood effects; use hands, vehicle radio, or a placed radio.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_LanguageMode_tooltip: 0 Auto, 1 English, 2 Russian, 3 Simplified Chinese. Force a language on servers when auto-detection picks the wrong pack.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_LineColors_tooltip: Colors lines by tone or speaker: horror, warnings, Bookman, Dispatch, Pastor, and system fragments.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_ListenCooldownMinutes: In-game minutes before the same listener can receive another XP or mood effect. Does not change how often broadcasts air.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_MaxIntervalMinutes_to: Maximum in-game minutes between Louisville Relay broadcasts.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_MaxLinesPerBroadcast_: How many text-pack entries can be sent in one broadcast. Serial arcs still play as coherent episodes.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_MinIntervalMinutes_to: Minimum in-game minutes between Louisville Relay broadcasts.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_StartDelayMinutes_too: In-game minutes after world start before the first possible broadcast.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_TextMode_tooltip: Chooses where broadcast text is loaded from: 0 built-in only, 1 built-in plus custom overlays, 2 custom only with built-in fallback. Does not change language.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_UnhappinessMultiplier: Scales only positive unhappiness effects from broadcasts. 50 means half depression. Relief messages, panic, boredom, and XP are not reduced.
Sandbox_NeuroRadio_WorldRadioRadius_tool: Tile range where a tuned radio placed in the world can trigger XP and mood effects. Set 0 to ignore placed radios for effects.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_CatchUpOnChunkLo: When a chunk loads, immediately reconcile any timer-configured lights so they match their schedule. Disable if this causes performance issues.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOffHour_t: Hour (0-23) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOffMin_to: Minute (0-59) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOnHour_to: Hour (0-23) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOnMin_too: Minute (0-59) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle for the mod. Disable to revert to vanilla behavior.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorDefa: Minutes (1-60) prefilled in the motion-sensor dialog. Controls how long the light stays on after the last detected motion.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorDete: When enabled, motion sensors trigger on zombies in addition to players — useful for spotting an intruder from a distance, but adds per-square scanning cost. Disable to reduce CPU load on busy servers or if you find it gives away too much.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorEnab: Master toggle for the motion-sensor switch feature. When off, installed sensors stop reacting to players (and craft recipes still work but installs are blocked).
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorPoll: How often motion sensors check for nearby players, in game-tick frames. Lower = snappier response, higher = lower CPU cost. Default 10 ≈ 6 polls per second at 60 FPS.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorSkil: Minimum Electrical skill to install or configure a motion sensor when the item requirement above is off. Set to 0 for no gate.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_OutdoorMotionSen: Tile radius (1-20) within which an Outdoor Motion Sensor will detect players. Indoor sensors ignore this and use room boundaries instead.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequireMotionSen: When enabled, players must craft and install an Indoor or Outdoor Motion Sensor item to motion-enable a light. When disabled, the skill gate below applies instead.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequireTimerItem: When enabled, players must craft a Light Timer item and install it on a light before they can set a schedule. When disabled, any light can be configured directly, gated only by the Required Electrical skill below.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequiredElectric: Minimum Electrical skill to configure a light timer. Only applies when "Require Timer item" is off — otherwise the skill cost is in crafting the Timer. Set to 0 for no gate.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_MuscleFatigu: Applies vanilla muscle fatigue to the body regions trained by the bench press and treadmill when the exercise ends.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_DisableAttackIfStress: Animals will no longer attack players when stressed.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_DisableCanDoLaceratio: Animals will no longer be able to cause laceration wounds on characters.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_DisableKnockdownAttac: Animals will no longer be able to knock down characters with their attacks.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_DisableStressAboveGro: Animals will no longer become stressed from being above ground.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_DisableStressUnderRai: Animals will no longer become stressed when exposed to rain.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_EnableZenGenome_toolt: When enabled, the stress gene range is locked to 0 so all newly spawned animals start genetically calm.
Sandbox_ZenAnimals_EnableZeroStress_tool: All animals inside animal zones will have 0 stress.

Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ActiveSpeed_tool: Zombie speed during the active night hours. Default is 1. 1 = Sprinters, 2 = Fast Shamblers, 3 = Shamblers, 4 = Random.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractEveryTick: How often the player tracking pulse fires while the event is active. Default is 180 ticks. Lower happens more often and is more intense but heavier. Higher is calmer and lighter.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractRadius_to: How far the night tracking pulse reaches. Default is 250 tiles. Higher pulls zombies from farther away but can be heavier. Lower is safer for performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractVolume_to: How strong the tracking sound is. Default is 250. Higher makes zombies respond more aggressively to the pulse. Lower makes it weaker.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractZombies_t: When ON, the mod creates a timed sound pulse during active Moonlight Mayhem hours only. Default is OFF. When the night ends, the pulse stops and cleanup runs.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_DaysBetweenEvent: Controls how often Moonlight Mayhem repeats. Default is 1, meaning every night. 2 means every other night, 3 means every third night.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_DebugPrint_toolt: Shows Moonlight Mayhem messages in the console. Default is OFF. Turn this ON only when testing or troubleshooting.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EnableNightSpawn: When ON, extra zombies can spawn near the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is OFF. This is separate from changing existing zombies; existing zombies are handled by the refresh settings.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. ON means the mod checks the chosen time window and applies the night zombie settings. OFF means it stops changing zombie behavior.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EndHour_tooltip: The hour when Moonlight Mayhem ends, using 24-hour time. Default is 6, which means 6 AM. Zombies are restored to normal after this time.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EndMinute_toolti: The minute when the event ends. Default is 0. Example: End Hour 6 and End Minute 30 means the event ends at 6:30 AM.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_FallbackDaySpeed: The speed zombies return to when Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 3, normal Shamblers. This also acts as a backup if the original speed cannot be read.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_FirstEventDay_to: The first survival day Moonlight Mayhem can happen. Default is 1, meaning it can start on the first night.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ImmediateRefresh: How many loaded zombies are refreshed immediately when night starts or ends. Default is 300. Higher values change more zombies immediately; lower values are safer for performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_LoadedZombieAler: How far loaded zombies are directly pushed toward the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is 120 tiles. This only affects zombies already loaded nearby.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_PostRestorePasse: Extra cleanup checks after Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 30. Higher values do more follow-up cleanup so spawned or loaded zombies return to daytime settings after the event ends.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_RefreshTicks_too: How often the mod checks whether it should be night or day mode. Default is 300. Lower values check more often but may add stutter; higher values check less often and can be smoother.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnChance_tool: Chance that a night spawn attempt actually happens. Default is 100. Lower values make spawns less reliable and easier on performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnCount_toolt: How many zombies to spawn per successful night spawn. Default is 5. Higher is harder but can hurt performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnEveryMinute: How many in-game minutes between night spawn attempts. Default is 30. Lower means more frequent spawns. Higher means fewer spawns.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnMaxDistance: Farthest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 120 tiles. Higher spreads spawns farther out; lower keeps them closer.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnMinDistance: Closest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 45 tiles. Higher keeps spawns farther away from the player.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_StartHour_toolti: The hour when Moonlight Mayhem begins, using 24-hour time. Default is 18, which means 6 PM. Zombies switch to the night settings when this time starts.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_StartMinute_tool: The minute when the event begins. Default is 0. Example: Start Hour 20 and Start Minute 30 means the event begins at 8:30 PM.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ZombieRefreshBat: How many loaded zombies are refreshed per tick while a transition queue is active. Default is 300. Higher values refresh more zombies per pass; lower values spread the work out more slowly.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_tooltip: Timed zombie-night settings. Default is 6 PM to 6 AM. Test build uses night speed switching plus attraction pulse only; strength, hearing, sight, and memory options were removed for troubleshooting.

Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyFatigueThreshold_tool: Fatigue level (0-100) above which Adrenaline Frenzy can activate.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyMaxTime_tooltip: Max time that Adrenaline Frenzy can last. After this time, the effect automatically ends.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyMoveSpeedBonus_toolti: Percentage bonus to movement speed during Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyStreakThreshold_toolt: Minimum kill streak required to trigger Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_HallucinationCeaseLevel_too: Insanity level at which hallucinations stop occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_InsanityXP_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for butchering a corpse. <LINE> Note: XP values are calculated based on the meat quality and amount of meat obtained from the corpse, using the same logic as vanilla butchering skill. <LINE> Increasing this value will significantly increase the amount of Insanity XP gained from butchering.  <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_IntrusiveThoughtsStartingCh: Base chance of an intrusive thought occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_LaughChance_tooltip: Chance of the character laughing involuntarily.
Sandbox_PK42_OnEatCookedPlayerInfectionC: Chance of getting infected when eating cooked zombie meat if the player is not a psychopath.
Sandbox_PK42_OnEatCookedPsychopathInfect: Chance of getting infected when eating cooked zombie meat if the player is a psychopath.
Sandbox_PK42_SBSeparator_tooltip: It does nothing, it's just a separator for better organization of the settings in the menu.
Sandbox_PK42_SkinCorpseUnlockLevel_toolt: Insanity level required to unlock the ability to skin a corpse.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnFrenzyStart_t: Chance (0-100) to say a line when Adrenaline Frenzy activates. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnHitZombie_too: Chance (0-100) to say a line when hitting a zombie. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnKillPlayer_to: Chance (0-100) to say a line when killing another player. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnKillZombie_to: Chance (0-100) to say a line when killing a zombie. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechCooldown_tooltip: Time (in seconds) between allowed speech instances.
Sandbox_PK42_VehicleJumpscareChance_tool: Chance of a jumpscare event occurring then exiting a vehicle.
Sandbox_PK42_VisualHallucinationStarting: Base chance of a visual hallucination occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_XPDailyCap_tooltip: Maximum Insanity XP the character can earn per in-game day for each action type. Requires Enable XP Daily Cap to be active. <LINE> Note: This cap is applied over BASE XP values, players can gain more Insanity XP than the cap if they have read a book to boost it.
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatCookedZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Cooked Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatCookedZombieMeat_too: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating cooked zombie meat. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRawZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Raw Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRawZombieMeat_toolti: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating raw zombie meat. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat.  <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRecipeZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Recipe Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRecipeZombieMeat_too: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating zombie meat as part of a recipe. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillPlayer_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing another player. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillZombieOnFrenzy_tool: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing a zombie while Adrenaline Frenzy is active. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillZombie_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing a zombie. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_FishDryDays_too: How many in-game days fish takes to dry on the meat rack (fillets and whole fish). Default 3.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays_to: How many in-game days meat takes to dry into jerky on the meat rack. Default 10.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_PolendwicaDryDa: How many in-game days polendwica takes to dry on the meat rack. Default 5.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_AutoCoagulateChance_to: Chance per minute to auto-coagulate a bleeding wound when that upgrade is unlocked.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_ColdDecayAmount_toolti: Overall health lost while the symbiote is cold.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_FireDamageMultiplier_t: Extra fire damage taken by symbiotes.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_MergeChance_tooltip: Percent chance to become a symbiote when a merge roll succeeds.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_MergeTiming_tooltip: 1 = roll when Knox infection begins. 2 = roll when infection would kill you (last-chance merge).
Sandbox_Symbiosis_MinEssenceToCast_toolt: Powers cannot be used below this overall body health percentage.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_PassiveHealthMultiplie: Symbiotes regenerate overall health this many times faster than baseline.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_SymbioteVisuals_toolti: 1 = Off, 2 = overhead marker only, 3 = body overlay only, 4 = both (default). Body overlay uses mod textures under media/textures/Body/symbiosis/.
Sandbox_Symbiosis_XPPerPowerUse_tooltip: Base XP awarded when using an unlocked symbiosis power.
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_CivilianVehicles:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate inside normal civilian trunks and gloveboxes.

Examples:
0.0 = No Spawns
0.5 = Half Spawns
1.0 = Default Balanced
2.0 = Double Spawns
5.0 = 5x Spawns
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Civilian_tooltip:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate in household Kitchens and Garages.

Examples:
0.0 = No Spawns
0.5 = Half Spawns
1.0 = Default Balanced
2.0 = Double Spawns
5.0 = 5x Spawns
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Commercial_toolt:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate in Hunting Stores, Warehouses, and Logistics Centers.

Examples:
0.0 = No Spawns
0.5 = Half Spawns
1.0 = Default Balanced
2.0 = Double Spawns
5.0 = 5x Spawns
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_TacticalVehicles:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate inside Military, Police, and Ranger vehicles.

Examples:
0.0 = No Spawns
0.5 = Half Spawns
1.0 = Default Balanced
2.0 = Double Spawns
5.0 = 5x Spawns
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Tactical_tooltip:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate in Military Bases, Police Stations, and Gun Stores.

Examples:
0.0 = No Spawns
0.5 = Half Spawns
1.0 = Default Balanced
2.0 = Double Spawns
5.0 = 5x Spawns
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowAmmoLoot_: Allows ammunition boxes in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowFoodLoot_: Allows food and water in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowMedicalLo: Allows bandages, disinfectants and medical supplies.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowMilitaryL: Allows weapons, military accessories and military clothing in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowRareLoot_: Allows controlled rare items. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowSurvivalL: Allows survival items such as matches, tarps, knives and water purification tablets.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowToolsLoot: Allows useful tools such as hammers, saws, crowbars and hand axes.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropCraterDecorati: Adds scorched floor tiles/overlays around the crate, with a safe fallback if a sprite fails.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDeadBodyMax_to: Maximum number of dead bodies created near the airdrop when decorations are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDeadBodyMin_to: Minimum number of dead bodies created near the airdrop when decorations are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropFixedPointSear: Radius, in tiles, used around each fixed point to find a loaded valid square if the exact point is not valid.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropIntervalHours_: Real server hours between automatic attempts to create an airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLifetimeMinute: Real minutes before the server removes the container, timer and marker.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLocationMaxAtt: Maximum number of candidate points tested around the player before canceling the spawn attempt.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLootDifficulty: Multiplies the world-difficulty adjustment applied to airdrop loot.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLootLevel_tool: Controls the default loot quality, zombie count, zombie radius and special zombie rules for each airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMarkerApproxRa: Radius, in tiles, of the approximate circle shown only inside the world map. It does not reveal the exact crate.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMarkerColor_to: Color used by the blinking map circle and direction arrow.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxActiveEvent: Kept at 1 for safety: the server should never have more than one active airdrop at a time.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxDistanceFro: Maximum distance, in tiles, used when searching for a valid location around the selected player.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxItems_toolt: Maximum number of items generated inside the airdrop container. Ignored when level defaults are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxSameItemRep: Maximum number of times the same item can appear in one airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMinDistanceFro: Minimum distance, in tiles, between the selected player and the airdrop location.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMode_tooltip: Mode 1 picks one player and sends a private marker. Mode 2 uses fixed map points and sends the marker/timer to every online player.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropShowDirectionA: Shows a world direction arrow pointing to the approximate airdrop zone. It does not point to the exact location.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropShowMapMarker_: Shows an approximate circle only inside the world map. It does not create a ground circle.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropSpawnDecoratio: Adds bodies, blood and scorched marks around the airdrop. It does not cause real map damage.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropTriggerChopper: When enabled, the server asks an online admin client to execute /chopper after a successful airdrop spawn.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelDe: When enabled, the selected loot level controls zombie min/max, zombie radius, item count and category weights. Disable this to use the manual values below.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieMax_tool: Maximum number of zombies created around the airdrop. Ignored when level defaults are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieMin_tool: Minimum number of zombies created around the airdrop. Ignored when level defaults are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSpawnRad: Radius, in tiles, used to distribute event zombies around the container. Ignored when level defaults are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_Debug_tooltip: Logs spawn, location validation, loot, zombies and cleanup details to the server log.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or disables the server-side airdrop event scheduler.
Sandbox_PIP_ChargesPerBag_tooltip: How many crops one poured bag can fertilize. Independent of barrel water volume.
Sandbox_PIP_DebugLogs_tooltip: Prints internal logs to the console. For troubleshooting only.
Sandbox_PIP_EnableAutoWatering_tooltip: When on, pipes automatically water nearby crops from connected rain barrels.
Sandbox_PIP_EnableFertigation_tooltip: When on, pour Fertilizer or Compost into a connected rain barrel and the pipe network auto-fertilizes nearby crops (one safe dose per crop, never over-fertilizes). On by default.
Sandbox_PIP_FertigationSkill_tooltip: Simulated Farming skill used when auto-fertilizing. Higher = better chance of a yield bonus. Does not affect safety.
Sandbox_PIP_SharedWaterPool_tooltip: When on, barrels connected in the same network share and balance their water (a full and an empty barrel even out).
Sandbox_PIP_SmartPipesFillMax_tooltip: Maximum water level added to a crop per cycle in Smart Pipes mode.
Sandbox_PIP_SmartPipes_tooltip: When on, pipes fill crops up to their optimal water level. When off, they add a fixed small amount each cycle.
Sandbox_PIP_WateringInterval_tooltip: In-game minutes between each watering cycle.
Sandbox_PIP_WateringRadius_tooltip: 0 = the pipe's own tile only. Higher values water crops in a square area around each pipe.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ActiveDeviceLimit_toolt: Hard cap on actively synced/playback-managed devices per client.
Sandbox_NewMusic_AudioMaxRadius_tooltip: How far (in tiles) world playback devices can be heard at max volume. (Effects zombie attraction radius)
Sandbox_NewMusic_BatteryDrainRate_toolti: How fast the battery drains in real life hours.
Sandbox_NewMusic_BoomboxSpawnPreset_tool: Preset rarity for boombox devices. Choose Custom to use the numeric Boombox Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDPlayerSpawnPreset_too: Preset rarity for CD players. Choose Custom to use the numeric CD Player Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDsSpawnPreset_tooltip: Preset rarity for CDs. Choose Custom to use the numeric CDs Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CDsSpawnRate_tooltip: Controls CD media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CassettesSpawnPreset_to: Preset rarity for cassettes. Choose Custom to use the numeric Cassettes Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_CassettesSpawnRate_tool: Controls cassette media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_Disassembly_tooltip: Enables disassembly and scrap for New Music devices.
Sandbox_NewMusic_MaxTrackingRange_toolti: Determines how far each client retains tracking for active devices. Set to 0 for infinite range.
Sandbox_NewMusic_RecordPlayerSpawnPreset: Preset rarity for record players. Choose Custom to use the numeric Record Player Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_VinylRecordsSpawnPreset: Preset rarity for vinyl records. Choose Custom to use the numeric Vinyl Records Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_VinylRecordsSpawnRate_t: Controls vinyl media spawn intensity. 0.00 disables.
Sandbox_NewMusic_WalkmanSpawnPreset_tool: Preset rarity for walkman devices. Choose Custom to use the numeric Walkman Spawn Rate value.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ZomboidOST_tooltip: Allows the base mod Zomboid OST items to spawn. Uncheck to disable them.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_GeneratorRefuelTarget: When auto-refuelling, the generator is topped up to this percentage of its tank (100 = full).
Sandbox_WaterPipes_GeneratorRefuelThresh: A plumbed generator pulls fuel from the network once its tank drops below this percentage of its capacity. Set to 0 to disable auto-refuelling.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_AllowDebugSpawn_to: Show a right-click ground option to spawn test dogs (admins only in multiplayer).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_AutoProtectEnabled: Enables the per-dog Auto-protect toggle: when on, a dog stands guard anchored on you while you sleep, eat, read, sit or fish, then goes back to following. Turn this off to disable the feature entirely.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BondingEnabled_too: Petting your dog and sleeping beside it ease your Bored and Unhappy moodles a little. Petting also calms the dog and nudges its loyalty.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedChancePerDay_: Percent chance per in-game day that a nearby adult male and female of the same owner conceive on their own (rolled hourly). Same conditions as manual breeding: fed, loyal, healthy, off cooldown, a free dog slot, breeding not blocked on either. Only while loaded near you. 0 = off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedingEnabled_to: Allow companion dogs (a male and female with the same owner) to mate and have puppies. Disabling hides the breeding action.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityBase_: Minimum cargo weight a saddlebag can hold before the dog's Strength gene adds more. A weak dog (caramelo) gets about this much; this is the floor.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacitySpan_: Extra cargo weight a maximally strong dog adds on top of the base capacity. A strong breed (German Shepherd) approaches base + this; a weak one adds little.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CombatEnabled_tool: Allow companion dogs to attack nearby zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DespawnOnOwnerOffl: Stash dogs while owner is offline

Multiplayer servers: when a player disconnects, their dogs are safely stored out of the world (state and needs preserved, frozen) and returned when they reconnect. The active dog in Follow comes back at the owner's side; dogs in Stay/Guard and passive dogs reappear where they were left once the area loads. On by default; turn it off to keep dogs of offline players in the world (invincible and idle).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogNoiseAttractsZo: The dog's loud barking (stress barks and loud sentinel alerts) is real noise that draws nearby zombies (the symmetric cost). Quiet growls never attract. Turn off to bark without drawing zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogSpawnMultiplier: Scales how often stray dogs appear in the world (caramelo strays, Golden Retrievers and police German Shepherds), keeping their relative rarity. 1.0 is the normal rate; 2.0 doubles all dog spawns, 0 disables them.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_GestationDays_tool: How many in-game days a pregnant dog carries before giving birth.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_HuntEnabled_toolti: Master switch for assisted hunting. A dog in Hunt mode tracks wild game (rabbit, raccoon, deer...) and, once trained, chases and takes it for you. Hunting is rural - game lives in forests and the countryside, not in town.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_LoyaltyDecayPerDay: Loyalty points (0-100) a cared-for dog loses each in-game day. Decay is faster while it is hungry or thirsty.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaturityDays_toolt: How many in-game days a puppy takes to grow into an adult, keeping its bond, genes and skills. Puppies age only while loaded near a player; 'Pause growth' on a puppy overrides this.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaxCompanions_tool: Maximum number of dogs a player can keep bonded at once. 0 = no limit. At the cap, taming new strays is blocked (the befriend option turns red); releasing or losing a dog frees a slot.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffEnabled_: After you sleep next to your dog, you wake up Well Rested for a while: a gentle, temporary buff that eases panic, stress, sadness and boredom and lets you tire more slowly. Turn this off to disable it.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffHours_to: How many in-game hours the Well Rested buff lasts after waking up beside your dog. Default 2.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SentinelEnabled_to: The dog watches a wide area and warns you about zombies: a quiet growl for distant or few, a loud bark for close, many, or visible ones.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ShowMapMarker_tool: Mark your companion dog on the world map and minimap. The marker follows the dog while it's nearby and stays at its last seen spot when the dog is out of range, so you can find a dog you left behind or lost after dying.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ShowNameTags_toolt: Draw each companion dog's name floating above its head in the world.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SkillXPRate_toolti: Global multiplier on all skill XP gains (scent, combat, obedience, hunting). 1.0 is normal; higher trains faster.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SkillsEnabled_tool: Companions learn skills (scent, combat, obedience...) by doing, improving their effectiveness over time.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TameThreshold_tool: How much trust a dog must reach (by feeding) before it becomes your companion.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_UpkeepEnabled_tool: Companions need care: feed them to keep hunger, loyalty and stress in check. A neglected dog disobeys.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_UrbanSpawnEnabled_: Stray caramelo mutts appear on their own in cities and residential neighbourhoods as you explore, ready to be befriended.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_WildDogsInvincible: Stray, wild and released dogs cannot be killed (by zombies, your own hits, vehicles, hunger or fire). Off by default. Turn it on for a gentler world where a stray you find is always safe to tame. Companion dogs are already invincible regardless of this.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_ActionTimeMult: Controls how long fuel transfer actions take. Lower is faster. Higher is slower. Default is 1.0.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_AdditionalTank: Advanced manual fallback. Comma, semicolon, pipe, or line separated vehicle script names to treat as fuel tankers. Admins can also use Fuel Tanker > Fuel Tanker Admin from the right-click menu; it appears below Help and does not require a nearby tanker. AM General trucks are selected by default and can be removed in the admin manager. Example: Base.StepVan; Base.PickUpTruck
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_EnableRadialMe: Enables Fuel Tanker options in the vehicle radial menu.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_EnableRightCli: Enables the Fuel Tanker right-click context menu options.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_MaxTransferDis: Maximum distance allowed for tanker interactions and nearby vehicle transfers. Default is 16 tiles.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_TankerCapacity: Maximum fuel capacity for supported tanker trucks, in liters. Existing tankers are clamped to this value when loaded.
Sandbox_FuelTankerOptions_VehicleTransfe: When enabled, refueling vehicles from the tanker and siphoning vehicles into the tanker require a rubber hose or siphon hose.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_AttractionRadius_to: Radius of the sound that pulls zombies toward the player. Must be larger than max spawn distance. Default: 1500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_AttractionVolume_to: Intensity of the attraction sound. Higher = more zombies attracted. Default: 1500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CooldownSeconds_too: Minimum time in seconds between two hordes for the SAME player. Independent from other players unless Global cooldown is enabled. 900 = 15 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoBaseSize_t: Number of zombies in wave 1. Each following wave is multiplied by the Multiplier. Example: base=5 x2 = 5, 10, 20, 40. Default: 5.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoChance_too: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a crescendo. Default: 10%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoDistMin_to: Minimum spawn distance for each wave. Each wave arrives from a different random direction. Default: 15.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoEnabled_to: The crescendo horde sends multiple waves of zombies at regular intervals, each larger than the last. The player cannot rest between waves — unkilled zombies stack up with each new wave.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoMultiplier: Size multiplier between waves as a percentage. 200 = x2 (double), 150 = x1.5, 300 = x3. Example with base=5 and x2: wave 1=5, wave 2=10, wave 3=20, wave 4=40. Default: 200.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoWaveDelayS: Real-world seconds between each new wave. 30 = 30 seconds to kill the current wave before the next arrives. Minimum: 5 seconds. Default: 30.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoWaves_tool: Total number of waves. Wave 1 spawns immediately, subsequent waves arrive after the configured delay. Default: 4 waves.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_Debug_tooltip: Outputs technical logs to console.txt. Disable in normal play.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_EnableDebugContextM: Enables admin options in the right-click menu: force a horde, view status, reset cooldown.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or completely disables the mod.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GlobalPlayerCooldow: If > 0, when a horde spawns on any player, ALL players are protected for this many seconds. Prevents two simultaneous hordes on the server. 0 = disabled. Example: 300 = nobody can get a horde for 5 minutes after any horde spawns.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GroupSizeMax_toolti: Maximum zombies in a normal horde (before scaling). Hard limit: 500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GroupSizeMin_toolti: Minimum zombies in a normal horde (before scaling).
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MPAttractionDelaySe: Seconds before sending the zombie attraction signal in MP. Too short = zombies miss the signal. Default: 10.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MPSpawnClamp_toolti: MULTIPLAYER ONLY. Limits spawn radius to stay in the loaded zone. Reduce if zombies vanish on spawn. Default: 75.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantChance_tool: Every 15 in-game minutes, chance that a merchant spawns near a player if a valid spot is found. Default: 25%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantDespawnMinu: Time before an inactive merchant (no nearby player, no ongoing trade) disappears along with his vehicle. Default: 20 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantEnabled_too: A merchant NPC can appear near a road with his vehicle parked on the roadside.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantMaxDistance: Maximum distance from the player when searching for a merchant spawn spot.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantMinDistance: Minimum distance from the player when searching for a merchant spawn spot.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NeighborNotifyRadiu: Players within this radius are warned when a horde is triggered nearby. 0 = disabled. Default: 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NewPlayerGraceSecon: How long after connecting a player cannot be targeted. 0 = disabled. Default: 600 = 10 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightEndHour_toolti: In-game hour at which night ends. Default: 5. Midnight crossing handled automatically.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightOnly_tooltip: If enabled, hordes can only spawn during nighttime in-game.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightStartHour_tool: In-game hour at which night starts. Default: 21.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NormalChance_toolti: STEP 2: If a horde must spawn, this % is the chance it is a normal horde. The 6 types should ideally add up to 100. Example: Normal=35 Wandering=22 Surround=16 Pincer=12 Crescendo=10 Sprinter=5 = exactly 100%. If the total is not 100, the game recalculates automatically.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerChance_toolti: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a pincer. Ignored if pincer is disabled. The 4 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerDistMax_toolt: Maximum distance. Capped by MP Clamp in multiplayer. Default: 40.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerDistMin_toolt: Minimum distance from the player where each group spawns. Both groups spawn at this distance in opposite directions.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerEnabled_toolt: The pincer horde spawns two groups of zombies in opposite directions simultaneously (e.g. North AND South). The player is caught between them and must break through one line or flee sideways.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerGroupMin_tool: Minimum total zombies across both groups. Each group gets roughly half. Default: 10.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_RewardCrateChance_t: For each horde that spawns, chance that a reward crate appears at its spawn point. Default: 35%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_RewardCrateEnabled_: A wooden crate is placed at the horde's spawn point, with a few useful items (ammo, medical, food, sometimes a weapon) dropped on the ground next to it - as if it had been air-dropped when the horde arrived.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingInterval_too: Days between each difficulty increase. Default: 14.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingMaxPercent_t: Maximum horde size with scaling. 250 = x2.5 max.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingMode_tooltip: Increases horde size over survival time.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingPercent_tool: Extra zombies per step. Example: 20 = +20% every 14 days.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnChance_tooltip: STEP 1: Every 15 minutes, the game rolls a die. This is the probability a horde appears at all. Example: 50 = 50% chance. If the roll fails, nothing happens and we wait another 15 minutes. If it succeeds, we move to Step 2.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnDistMax_toolti: Maximum spawn distance. Capped by MP Clamp in multiplayer.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnDistMin_toolti: Minimum spawn distance. Too small = zombies in the player's field of view.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnSearchAttempts: Attempts to find a valid spawn tile. Higher = more reliable. Default: 64.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpecialZombieChance: For EACH spawned zombie, chance it wears a special outfit instead of a normal random one. With a 50-zombie horde and 6%, roughly 3 zombies will be special. The player gets notified if any were spotted. Default: 6%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpecialZombieEnable: A small percentage of zombies in each horde will spawn wearing a special outfit (military, police, doctor, fire officer, ranger, hazmat...). These zombies carry interesting lootable equipment to reward the player for searching bodies after the fight.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterChance_tool: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a sprinter horde. Keep low as it is very dangerous. Default: 5%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterDistMin_too: Minimum spawn distance. Similar to normal since sprinters close distance quickly. Default: 15.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterEnabled_too: The sprinter horde spawns a SMALL group of sprinting zombies. Very rare by default as it is extremely dangerous. Uses B42 doSprinter() API to force zombie speed.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterGroupMax_to: Maximum number of sprinters. Beyond 8 it becomes nearly unplayable. Default: 8.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterGroupMin_to: Minimum number of sprinters. Keep small — 3 sprinters are already very dangerous. Default: 3.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundChance_tool: STEP 2: Chance the horde is an encirclement (zombies in a full circle around the player). Ignored if encirclement is disabled. The 3 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundDistMax_too: Maximum distance. Each zombie has +-15 degree variation for a natural circle.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundDistMin_too: Minimum distance of each zombie. Recommended: at least 25 tiles.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundEnabled_too: Zombies spawn in a full circle around the player. No obvious escape direction.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundGroupMin_to: Minimum zombies. With 8 zombies the circle has gaps.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingAttraction: Radius of the sound that directs the wandering horde toward its exit point. Default: 900.
Volume of the attraction sound for the wandering horde. Default: 900.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingChance_too: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a wandering one (passes near the player without targeting them). Ignored if wandering horde is disabled. The 3 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingDistMax_to: Maximum spawn distance for the wandering horde. Default: 120.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingDistMin_to: Minimum spawn distance for the wandering horde. Default: 80.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingEnabled_to: The wandering horde crosses the area without chasing the player. Staying silent may let it pass.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingExitDistan: Distance of the destination point. The horde walks past the player toward this point. Default: 200.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingGroupMax_t: Maximum zombies in a wandering horde. Default: 40.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingGroupMin_t: Minimum zombies in a wandering horde.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingSpread_too: Width of the 4-group formation. Larger = harder to avoid. Default: 18.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ZombieToothChance_t: For each zombie spawned in a horde, chance it carries a zombie tooth. Default: 10%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ZombieToothEnabled_: Horde zombies have a chance to carry a zombie tooth in their inventory, lootable from their corpse after being killed.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_AnimalLethal_toolti: On (default): launched animals die when they land. Off: they survive the flight, indignant but unharmed.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_AnimalUsesCharge_to: On (default): launching an animal wears the trap down like a zombie launch does. Off: flinging the chickens is free.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Charges_tooltip: Guaranteed launches before the mechanism starts wearing out. Past that, every launch rolls the Jam chance below. Set to 999 for an unbreakable trap.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_DeployGlobal_toolti: Off (default): deploying a Trample Steam requires Mechanics 2, a technical occupation (Engineer, Electrician, Mechanic, Metalworker), or having read the magazine. On: anyone can deploy one.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_FlightQuips_tooltip: If on (default), launched survivors blurt something out mid-flight. Turn off for a silent, dignified somersault.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_IdleSounds_tooltip: If on (default), an armed trap quietly hums (audible only a few tiles away, and only while it has fuel in gasoline mode).
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_InstantReset_toolti: If on, the trap re-arms in a quarter of a second (the swing animation still plays). If off, it takes the Reset time below before it can fire again.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_JamChance_tooltip: Once a trap has used up its charges it keeps working, but every further launch has this chance to jam the mechanism. Default 20. At 0 a worn trap never jams.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_LaunchAnimals_toolt: On (default): livestock and wildlife that wander onto the pad get launched too. Whether the flight kills them and whether it wears the trap are the two options below.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_LaunchPower_tooltip: Multiplies how far and how high victims are flung. 1 (default) is the normal spring; 0.5 is a polite shove, 4 is a catapult.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_NoiseAttraction_too: On (default): the launch bang, the ready ding and the idle hum are real noise that draws nearby zombies toward the trap, so it baits its own victims. Off: the sounds are audible to you only.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PackUpPermission: Who can pack up a trap
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PackUpPermission_to: Who is allowed to pack up (or scrap) a deployed Trample Steam. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' limits it to whoever deployed that trap, so rivals can't steal your defenses in PvP. Admins and the build cheat always can. Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerFallImmunity_: Off (default): a launched survivor can take falling damage on a hard landing, especially at high Launch power. On: trap launches never deal fall damage, so pads can be chained into a launch-transit network across the map.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerLaunchDamage_: Extra health a survivor loses when the trap launches them. 0 (the default) adds nothing, though a rough landing can still hurt a little depending on the launch angle and how you come down. Raise it to make stepping on your own trap properly dangerous.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerLaunch_toolti: Who the trap will launch besides zombies. 'Everyone but the owner' uses the name of whoever deployed the trap. 'Everyone but the owner's allies' also spares the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them: allies walk over the pad safely, raiders fly.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerUsesCharge_to: If on, launching a survivor wears the trap down like a zombie launch does. Off (default): bouncing players is free.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PowerMode_tooltip: What powers the trap. Gasoline: deploys empty, refuel from a gas can, sips roughly one tank per week.
