Generator/grid: runs while the tile has electricity (a powered building or a running generator nearby). Both (default): runs if EITHER fuel or electricity is available. None: always powered.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Preset_tooltip: Quickly switch the trap between play styles. 'Custom' uses the individual settings below as-is. 'Co-op PvE / Singleplayer' pins the recommended cooperative values (free harmless player launches, nothing restricted, no sabotage). 'Co-op PvE / Singleplayer Casual' is that plus safe landings, deployment as global knowledge, and traps that never need fuel or power. 'PvP' makes launches hit everyone for 35 damage and use a charge, turns off the mid-flight remarks, restricts pack-up, siphoning and upgrades to the owner and their faction/safehouse allies, and enables sabotage. Settings the preset doesn't cover still come from this page. Server admins can flip this live from the Sandbox Options panel; it applies within a minute, no restart needed.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Ragdoll_tooltip: On (default): launched victims react like they were hit by a car, ragdolling as physics ragdolls (this forces the game's 'Use Physics Hit Reaction' display option on). Every victim leaves on its own slightly-off heading with its own tumble, and touchdown is a couple of shrinking bounces and a short skid, with a fresh ragdoll kick at each impact. Note: the game disables ragdoll physics in multiplayer (just like real car hits), so multiplayer uses the regular falldown animations. Off: victims are launched in a normal pose, land once and stop.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_RecipeGlobal_toolti: Off (default): the crafting recipe must be learned from the 'How to Use: Trample Steam' magazine (spawns as rarely as the generator magazine); Engineers and Metalworkers know it from the start. On: everyone knows the recipe.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ReinforcedCharges_t: Guaranteed launches after reinforcing a trap with extra sheet metal (context menu, needs welding gear). Set to 999 to make reinforced traps unbreakable.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ResetSeconds_toolti: Seconds the trap needs to re-cock and re-arm after firing, and to arm itself when first deployed (used only when Instant reset is off). Default 7.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Sabotage_tooltip: Off (default): deployed traps can't be tampered with. On: any survivor with a screwdriver and Electrical 2 can attempt to jam a deployed Trample Steam. Success quietly breaks it (repairable as usual); a botched attempt makes a loud clank that draws zombies. Higher Electrical skill improves the odds. PvP counter-play against enemy trap lines.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SiphonPermission: Who can siphon gasoline from a trap
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SiphonPermission_to: Who is allowed to siphon stored gasoline back out of a deployed trap into a gas can. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' stops fuel theft in PvP; 'Nobody' makes fueling a one-way trip. Admins and the build cheat always can. Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SoundDistance_toolt: Scales how far every trap sound carries -- the launch bang, the re-cock ratchet, the ready ding, the idle hum and the landing thud -- and equally how far away zombies can hear them (when Noise attracts zombies is on). The sounds keep their relative loudness; only the reach changes. 1 = the default curve, 0.1 = barely past the pad, 4 = the whole neighborhood hears it.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_TriggerDelay_toolti: Short delay between something stepping on the pad and the launch, letting more zombies pile on so one charge flings the whole group. Default 0.07; set to 0 to fire instantly.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_UpgradePermission_t: Who is allowed to upgrade a deployed Trample Steam -- one setting covers all three upgrades: Reinforcing, Camouflage and Spring tuning. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' stops rivals from re-skinning or de-tuning your defenses in PvP. Admins and the build cheat always can. On top of this, upgrading always needs the deployment know-how (Mechanics 2, a technical occupation, or the magazine). Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ZombieLethal_toolti: On (default): launched zombies die when they land. Off: they survive the flight and get back up. Launch them into another trap for zombie pinball.
Sandbox_NoSkillLoss_NotifyPlayer_tooltip: Shows an informational message in the game chat when skills are restored.
Sandbox_NoSkillLoss_ProtectionDuration_t: Determines how many seconds of spawn protection a player has upon birth. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_NoSkillLoss_RestorePercentage_to: Determines what percentage of skills is preserved when a player dies (0-100).
Sandbox_NoSkillLoss_RestoreRecipes_toolt: Determines whether learned cooking and crafting recipes will be restored.
Sandbox_VanillaTrappingFix_EnableTrapWar: If enabled, the character says a generic line when one of their traps needs checking.
Sandbox_PagerModTower: Pager Tower (Only Applies to Ultra Realistic)
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowBlocking_tooltip: Lets players block a pager number so its pages never reach them. Useful against griefers in PvP.
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowBroadcast_tooltip: Lets a player send one page to every pager on the network with the Broadcast button. Turn this off on busy servers to cut down on spam.
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowSOS_tooltip: Enables the emergency SOS button, which pages everyone on the network at once and attaches the sender's location (unless location sharing is Off).
Sandbox_PagerMod_BatteryLife_tooltip: How long a fresh battery powers a pager before it dies and must be replaced. Measured in in-game time. Replace batteries from the pager's right-click menu using a Battery item.
Sandbox_PagerMod_FactionScope_tooltip:
Controls who can reach who.
Anyone: any pager can page any other (the default).
Same faction only: members of different factions cannot page each other, so rival groups can't eavesdrop or spam. Players who are not in a faction can always be reached.
Sandbox_PagerMod_GlobalChat_tooltip: Adds a town-wide GLOBAL tab to every pager: a shared channel anyone with a pager can read and post to, reaching everyone regardless of saved contacts or faction. It still obeys the signal mode, receive-only mode, send cooldown and per-person blocking.
Sandbox_PagerMod_LocationSharing: Share your location on a page
Sandbox_PagerMod_LocationSharing_tooltip:
Whether a page can include where the sender is standing. The recipient then sees the coordinates plus distance and a compass bearing.
Off: location is never shared.
Ask each time: the sender ticks a box per page (the default).
Always on: every page carries the sender's location.
An SOS still shares location unless this is set to Off.
Sandbox_PagerMod_LogPages: Log pages to a server file
Sandbox_PagerMod_LogPages_tooltip: Appends every routed page (sender, recipient, text, delivered/queued/blocked) to PagerMod_PageLog.txt in the server's Zomboid folder. For admins/moderation.
Sandbox_PagerMod_MaxMessages_tooltip: How many pages a single pager keeps. Once it is full, the oldest page is dropped to make room for a new one.
Sandbox_PagerMod_MessageMaxLength_toolti: The longest message a player can put in one page, counted in characters.
Sandbox_PagerMod_NotifySound_tooltip: Play a beep and show an on-screen alert (with a preview of the message) whenever a new page comes in.
Sandbox_PagerMod_NumericOnly_tooltip: Pages may contain digits, spaces and dashes only - all letters are stripped out. Turns pagers into a numeric-code device.
Sandbox_PagerMod_PagerMode_tooltip:
What pagers can do.
Send and receive: normal two-way paging (the default).
Receive only: pagers can only receive pages - the compose, reply and group features are hidden.
Sandbox_PagerMod_Preset_tooltip:
Quick bundles of the options below.
Custom: nothing is overridden - every option on this page applies as you set it (the default).
Convenient: the relaxed defaults - map-wide signal, full two-way paging and every feature on.
Almost Realistic: a barely-functional pocket pager - 1 saved page, 16 characters, no location, no read receipts, no SOS, no blocking, no broadcast (still map-wide).
Ultra Realistic: everything in Almost Realistic, plus pagers can only receive (not send), and the network is map-wide only until the power dies, then needs a built, powered pager tower.
A preset overrides the matching options below.
Sandbox_PagerMod_ReadReceipts_tooltip: Notifies the sender once the person they paged has opened and read the message.
Sandbox_PagerMod_SendCooldown_tooltip: Minimum number of seconds a player must wait between sending pages. Helps stop spam and griefing on PvP servers. Set to 0 for no limit (the default).
Sandbox_PagerMod_SignalMode_tooltip:
How far pages travel.
Map-wide: pagers reach anywhere on the map (the default - pagers are your long-range tier, with walkie-talkies for medium range and voice chat up close).
Limited range: a page only arrives if the recipient is within the distance set below.
Powered tower only (after power dies): pages reach map-wide while the electricity grid is still on, but once the power goes out the network only works through a built, powered pager tower's coverage - so the pager network dies with the grid unless someone keeps a tower running on a generator.
Powered tower only: the network ALWAYS needs a built, powered pager tower in range, even while the grid is up.
Sandbox_PagerMod_SignalRange_tooltip: The reach distance in tiles (1 tile is about 1 metre), used by two signal modes: in Limited range it's the furthest a page can travel between sender and recipient; in Powered tower mode it's each tower's coverage radius (both ends of a page must be within it).
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerComms_tooltip:
What the tower base station (000-0001) itself can do.
Send and receive: the tower can send pages and be paged - its console has an inbox.
Send only: the tower can only send pages; it cannot be paged.
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerLimit_tooltip: The most pager towers a single player may have set up at once. Each tower is its own node with its own number and coverage circle. Set to 0 for no limit. Admins are exempt.
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerPower_tooltip:
What a deployed pager tower needs to run (Powered tower mode).
Grid or generator: mains electricity OR a running generator nearby (the default).
Generator only: only a running, fuelled generator beside it (ignores the power grid).
None: towers always work, no power needed.
Sandbox_ExplosivesOptions_FireDamageEnab: When enabled, zombies take additional damage while on fire, regardless of the fire source. Disable to use vanilla fire behavior.
Sandbox_ExplosivesOptions_FireDamageMult: Multiplies the additional fire damage dealt to burning zombies. 0.5 = about 30% faster than vanilla, 1.0 = about twice as fast, 5.0 = about five times faster than vanilla.
Sandbox_ExplosivesOptions_LootMultiplier: Multiplies the spawn chance of all grenades and mines in loot containers. 0.5 = half as frequent, 1.0 = default, 2.0 = twice as frequent.
Sandbox_ExplosivesOptions_MinesEnabled_t: <BHC> [!] WARNING: Due to a Project Zomboid engine bug, a red error box will appear when a mine explodes after save/load. This is purely cosmetic and does not affect gameplay in any way. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>\n\n Enables the M14 Mine and M18A1 Claymore.
Sandbox_SoapZ_EnableOdorAttraction_toolt: If enabled, a very dirty or bloody character can attract zombies through wind-carried body odor. Soaps reduce that exposure.
Sandbox_SoapZ_OdorAttractionRange_toolti: Maximum distance in tiles at which body odor can attract zombies. With wind, the odor plume travels in that direction without exceeding this range.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActorUpdatesPerTic: Maximum survivors considered by the staggered scheduler each frame. Two is recommended for servers and large saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseMarkerRadius_t: Visual radius in tiles for the Home Base border. This is not a safehouse claim, just a Knox Survivors command-area outline.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseUpkeepHours_to: How often bases consume a small amount of food, water, and high-tier repair materials. Shorter values make settlements harder to maintain.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CombatEngageRadius: Distance at which survivors consider nearby zombies for defend/aggressive behavior. Lower values reduce CPU and reckless chasing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeprecatedCompatib: Kept only so older saves do not log unknown SandboxOption errors. This option no longer enables debug or testing features.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DormantActorDistan: Distance from the player where non-following survivor actors can be unloaded back into lightweight world simulation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableAutoBaseUpgr: Lets independent survivor camps spend gathered supplies to improve from wood shelter to reinforced and metal fortifications.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableBaseMarkers_: Shows a square-tile border around your active Home Base plus filled square-tile work area highlights. Client-side visual only; safe to disable on servers.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDebugLogging: Writes throttled Knox Survivors diagnostic logs for AI, movement, windows, doors, zones, base jobs, combat, spawning, and module load checks. Leave off for normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDormantActor: Removes far-off survivor actor shells from active simulation while keeping their persistent profile alive. This is a key performance feature for long saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableEncounters_t: Allows the world director to create persistent solo survivors and small survivor groups.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionMerge: Small friendly AI factions may combine into one camp when relations are high, avoiding too many tiny groups.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionTrade: Friendly AI survivor factions can trade spare supplies instead of fighting, helping the world feel more human.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionWars_: Lets independent survivor factions develop rivalries and occasionally raid each other for weapons/supplies. They target rival AI factions, not players.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableIdentityTags: Shows occasional lightweight Ally/Friendly/Wary/Territorial tags over nearby survivors so they do not feel like mystery zombies.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableOffscreenJob: Simulates settlement jobs once per in-game hour without spawning or pathfinding distant actors.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnablePrototypeCom: Enables measured close-range combat, injury, morale, fatigue, retreat, and death.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableSafeZombieSu: Lets nearby zombies notice and pressure survivor shells using short safe movement checks without direct survivor-as-zombie target forcing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableSurvivorBark: Allows rare low-spam survivor status lines about needs, stress, danger, and orders.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableZombiePursui: When enabled, vanilla zombies visually pursue and attack survivor NPCs. Verified working with zombie-shell actors in B42.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterChance_to: Chance per ten in-game minutes to create an encounter when the local population is below its cap. Default is intentionally low so survivors stay rare and believable.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterCooldownH: Minimum in-game hours between natural survivor encounter spawns. Keeps survivors rare and prevents population spam.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterMaxDistan: Maximum spawn distance from the player inside loaded world space.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterMinDistan: Minimum spawn distance from the player. Higher values make survivors feel discovered naturally instead of popping in nearby.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionConflictRad: Distance between AI camps where factions can notice each other and become tense or hostile.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionMergeChance: Chance that two friendly nearby AI factions merge during a faction think cycle.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionThinkHours_: How often the coarse faction simulation checks resource pressure, nearby rivals, and raids.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionWarChance_t: Base chance for tense/rival factions to raid each other when they are close and low on supplies.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowDistance_too: How many tiles recruited survivors try to keep between themselves and their owner. Lower values keep companions tighter while still avoiding shoulder-to-shoulder crowding.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FriendlyEncounterC: Chance that a new encounter starts more open to the player. Friendly does not mean free recruitment; trust still matters.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_GroupBaseChance_to: Chance that a new survivor group claims a lightweight camp/home anchor with shared supplies and defense.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_GroupEncounterChan: Chance that an encounter is a small survivor group instead of a solo survivor.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_HostileEncounterCh: Chance that a new encounter starts territorial and hard to recruit. Hostile survivors warn and avoid instead of using risky player-attack code.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxBaseRadius_tool: Maximum radius for upgraded or expanded player and survivor bases.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxEncounterGroupS: Maximum survivors in a naturally spawned group. Three is the recommended vanilla-plus balance target.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxIndependentSurv: Cap for non-recruited living survivors. Helps keep the world alive without runaway population or server strain.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxMergedFactionSi: Prevents AI faction merging from creating huge camps that would hurt performance or balance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxNearbySurvivors: Maximum survivor actors kept active near the player.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxPersistentSurvi: Maximum number of living survivor profiles stored in the world.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxSquadSize_toolt: Caps each player's active recruited roster. Six is the balanced performance and difficulty target.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MotionUpdatesPerTi: Drives active pathfinding continuously while keeping a strict per-frame budget. Six is recommended for smooth solo movement.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_RecruitTrustRequir: Minimum trust needed before a neutral survivor accepts an invitation. Conversation gains are deliberately modest.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_RetreatHealthPerce: Survivors retreat instead of fighting when health falls below this percentage, or when morale/fatigue collapses.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDebugActions_t: Adds Knox-only test and diagnostic actions to the context menu. Leave off for normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithWife_tool: Optional roleplay start. Spawns one spouse companion near your starting location. They follow, fight, and need care like any other survivor. Uses a companion slot. Disable for standard solo survival.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorDamageMult: Scales survivor melee damage. The default is intentionally below player-level damage.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorDurability: Scales resistance to simulated zombie pressure. Survivors remain mortal at the default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ThreatRefreshMilli: How often nearby zombie pressure is indexed for active survivors and their owner. Higher values use less CPU.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieAggroRadius_: Maximum distance at which the shared threat pass can redirect a zombie toward a closer survivor.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieAggroUpdates: Maximum zombie-to-survivor target updates during each shared threat refresh. Lower this on very crowded saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieSurvivorAtte: Distance where zombies may pay attention to survivors when the survivor is closer than a real player target.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReloadAllMags_toolti: Enables/disables the menu to automatically reload all selected magazines.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReplaceBandage_toolt: Enables/disables the menu to directly replace dirty bandages.
Sandbox_CommonSense_WashOnly_tooltip: Enables/disables the menu for washing only equipped or unequipped items.
Sandbox_EnduranceOnSuccess_Name_tooltip: Whether stamana drain occurs when the player attempts to push over a zomboid (off), or only when a player succeeds (on).
Sandbox_NeedSprint_Name_tooltip: Decides whether the player must be sprinting in order to activate the chance to shove over a zomboid.
Sandbox_StrengthCoef_Name_tooltip: Determines how much each strength skill point contributes to increasing the chance of shoving a zombiod
Sandbox_StrengthSub_Name_tooltip: Subtracts from the strength level before multiplying by the Coefficent (strengthlvl - strengthSubtraction) * strengthCoefficent
Sandbox_fallChance_Name_tooltip: How much a someone with the football player perk multiplies the reduction of the chance of being tripped.
Sandbox_footballObject_Name_tooltip: Decides how much holding a football contributes to being able to push over a zomboid (via addition and can be in either the primary or secondary slot).
Sandbox_headOnAmount_Name_tooltip: Adjusts how directly you must be moving toward a zomboid to trigger a tackle (0 means any direction, while 1 would mean directly infront of you, with the cone of influence getting bigger as the number decreases).
Sandbox_nimbleCoef_Name_tooltip: Determines how much each nimble skill point contributes to reducing the chance of being tripped
Sandbox_playerPushAmount_Name_tooltip: How much having the Football Player perk adds onto the chance of you being able to knockdown a zomboid.
Sandbox_setBaseKnock_Name_tooltip: If greater than 0, will make the chance to knockdown a zomboid constant at the number provided, ignoring the strength or football player checks.
Sandbox_sprinterDif_Name_tooltip: Limits Head-On Vector to sprinters (maintains difficulty). If unchecked, applies to all zomboids.
Sandbox_sprintingCoef_Name_tooltip: Controls how much more likely you are to knockdown a zomboid when sprinting rather than regular running.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AffinityMult_tooltip: Multiplier on affinity / affection changes from conversation and quests. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AllowZombification_to: When ON, a recruited companion that gets bitten builds up infection and eventually TURNS into a zombie, permanently - for players who want that risk. When OFF (default), companions never zombify. Either way, the false zombification bug (companion turning after a reload for no reason) is always prevented.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsEnterVehicl: When ON, a following companion hops into your vehicle when you drive off (they board and are safely stowed - not physically seated) and step out next to you when you exit. Works with modded vehicles. This does not require the Bandits mod's own 'may enter vehicles' checkbox.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ImmortalCompanions_to: When ON, a recruited companion that would die is instead KNOCKED DOWN - it lies incapacitated until you open the V window and press 'Help up companion'. They still take damage, bleed, and get hungry/tired. Turn OFF for normal mortality (they can die for good). Zombification is a separate option below.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NPCPortrait3D_tooltip: Show a real head-and-shoulders 3D render of the NPC's face in the V window's profile tab and in conversation. EXPERIMENTAL - this uses the engine's character model widget, which had GPU trouble in an earlier build; test it before relying on it. Off = no portrait.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsCritical_tooltip: A need at or above this value makes the companion break off to take care of it (if a matching routine spot is assigned).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsRateMult_tooltip: How fast companion Hunger / Fatigue / Boredom / Hygiene rise. 1.0 = default, 0 = needs never rise.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_PauseNearPlayer_toolt: When on, neutral wanderers stop and face you when you stand close, so you can talk before they move on.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ProtectCompanions_too: When on, the player cannot hurt or kill a recruited companion.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_RestoreLostCompanions: If PZ's save/load loses a recruited companion, bring it back at its post (Stay tile / Guard spot / where it was). EXPERIMENTAL - it respawns the companion from a saved roster; test it on a backup save first. Off = no auto-restore (duplicates are still cleaned up regardless).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_UIScale_tooltip: Scales the companion dialog/UI window and its text. 1.0 = default. Raise it if the UI looks too small on a high-resolution screen (e.g. 1.25 or 1.5). Reopen the window after changing.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnCap_tooltip: Spawning pauses while at least this many un-recruited neutral survivors are already near you (a LOCAL throttle, not a total limit - explore and you'll keep finding more). 0 = no throttle.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnClan_tooltip: Spawn recruitable companions ONLY from the clan(s) you name here. Enter the clan's name EXACTLY as it appears in the Bandit Creator (the 'Name' field shown when you create or edit a clan, e.g. Survivors). For more than one clan, separate names with commas: Survivors, Recon. Leave EMPTY to use any friendly/companion clan. Names are case-insensitive. (A clickable clan checklist is also available in-game: right-click the ground -> NPC Core Editor -> Spawning tab.)
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawn_tooltip: How often a lone neutral survivor (recruitable) wanders into the area off-screen. Base Bandits almost never spawns friendly groups, so this fills that gap. Off disables it.
Sandbox_FanHeater_ConditionDecrease_tool: 100 is normal speed. 50 is half speed, 200 is double speed.
Sandbox_FanHeater_ForagingSpawns_tooltip: If checked, the heater can be found while foraging in urban areas.
Sandbox_FanHeater_PowerConsumption_toolt: Amount of fuel drained from a generator every 10 in-game minutes. (Actual Default = 0.005)
Sandbox_FanHeater_RadiusHigh_tooltip: Radius in tiles the heat reaches when on High power.
Sandbox_FanHeater_RadiusLow_tooltip: Radius in tiles the heat reaches when on Low power.
Sandbox_FanHeater_SpawnMultiplier_toolti: 1.0 is default spawn rate. 0.0 disables spawning completely. 2.0 doubles the spawn rate.
Sandbox_FanHeater_StorySpawns_tooltip: If checked, the heater can occasionally be found spawned loose on the floor in Survivor Houses and camps.
Sandbox_FanHeater_TempBoostHigh_tooltip: Degrees Celsius added to the room when on High power.
Sandbox_FanHeater_TempBoostLow_tooltip: Degrees Celsius added to the room when on Low power.
Sandbox_VacPack_DarkCraftSpillChance_too: Chance to spill/lose a meal when sealing it in the dark (0 = never, 100 = always). Only applies when it's too dark to see what you're doing.
Sandbox_VacPack_SealerCraftable_tooltip: If disabled, the Vacuum Sealer can no longer be built from scavenged parts - it can only be found as loot in Electronics Stores and similar locations.
Sandbox_VacPack_SealerDurabilityMax_tool: The highest possible number of seals a Vacuum Sealer can perform before it needs maintenance. Each Sealer randomly picks its own value between the minimum and maximum the first time it's used, and again every time it's repaired.
Sandbox_VacPack_SealerDurabilityMin_tool: The lowest possible number of seals a Vacuum Sealer can perform before it needs maintenance. Each Sealer randomly picks its own value between the minimum and maximum the first time it's used, and again every time it's repaired.
Sandbox_VacPack_SpawnChanceCrates_toolti: How likely the Vacuum Sealer is to spawn in generic electronics loot map-wide (warehouses, garages, attics, storage crates).
Sandbox_VacPack_SpawnChanceElectronicSto: Vacuum Sealer spawn chance - Electronics Stores
How likely the Vacuum Sealer is to spawn as loot in dedicated Electronics Stores.
Sandbox_VacPack_SpawnChanceGigamart: Vacuum Sealer spawn chance - Giga Mart
Sandbox_VacPack_SpawnChanceGigamart_tool: How likely the Vacuum Sealer is to spawn in the household electronics aisle inside Giga Mart.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to sidecar spawn chances - both for sidecars found loose in garages, storage units, and sheds, and for sidecars rarely pre-attached to a newly spawned bicycle. Set to 0 to disable sidecar spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt: When enabled, attaching containers makes the bike harder to turn and heavy cargo slows it down. Disable for vanilla bike handling regardless of load.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in turn rate when all 6 containers are attached. 0 = no turning penalty. Capped at 75% to keep the bike usable.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in bike speed at 20kg of cargo inside containers. Heavy cargo slows both pedal speeds proportionally; fast pedal stays faster than slow. 0 = no speed penalty.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to: When riding, zombies that physically press against you slow the bike - a single bump bleeds off a little speed, and being surrounded slows you toward a near-stop. Sustained contact from a full surround also knocks you off the bike.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t: Scales how hard contacting zombies slow you. 100 = default curve (1 zombie ~85% speed, 4+ near stop). Lower is gentler, higher is harsher. Does not affect the knock-off.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity: How close a zombie must be to count as touching. Higher widens the contact range slightly so zombies count from a touch further out; 0 requires true body overlap.
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableBlizzards_tool: If enabled, winter blizzards will occur more often (approximately a few times per month).
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableFailures_toolt: If enabled, generators may occasionally shut down due to low temperatures during winter.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures: Allows 3D printers to suffer jams, print failures, and extrusion errors.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl: Adjusts the chance of failures during printing.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSeveri: When a cursed journal inflicts a persistent or severe penalty, guarantee a forget slot and (for severe curses) richer skill rewards to keep opening worthwhile.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere: Extra percent of skill XP granted by a cursed reward journal when the applied curse was severe. Only applies when Cursed Severity Compensation is enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal: When enabled, cursed journals older than the expiration age open safely without applying a curse.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalExpira: In-game days before a cursed journal's curse goes dormant. Expired cursed journals still open into bloody reward journals, but no curse fires.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal: When enabled, opening a cursed journal reveals an omen hinting at the curse category (pain, ruin, or loss) and constrains the curse to that category.
Allows perceptive survivors to notice disguised cursed journals and read escalating Hint, Aware, and Exact curse warnings from Cat's Eyes, Foraging, Herbalist, and fieldcraft backgrounds.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh: Foraging level for Hint insight, letting survivors notice hidden-cursed journals. Cat's Eyes and fieldcraft traits can also reveal suspicious journals.
Foraging level that, with Cat's Eyes, Herbalist, or Park Ranger fieldcraft, gives Aware insight and reveals the curse's broad omen category.
Foraging level used for exact curse insight when exact effect insight is enabled.
When enabled, survivors meeting the Exact insight threshold can identify the specific curse effect in item hover tooltips and Breaking the Seal confirmation prompts.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_RealisticPurification: When on, taps no longer purify tainted water automatically: tainted water stays tainted until you run it through a purifier tile. Default: off, so taps serve clean water as before.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierFilterWear_to: How fast the electric purifier's filter wears out with use, as a percentage of the default rate. 100 = default (a full filter cleans about 5000 units of tainted water before it needs repair). 200 = wears twice as fast, 50 = half as fast. Set to 0 so filters never wear out and never need repairing.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogDamageMultiplie: Scales how much damage companion dogs deal to zombies, on top of each breed's power, skill level and Strength gene. 1.0 is the tuned default; higher hits harder, 0 makes their bite harmless. The weak caramelo mutt still can't finish a zombie on its own no matter how high this is set - that is by design.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CountDogKillsForPl: When on, zombies killed by your dog also add to your own 'Zombie Kills' count on the character info screen. On by default. Your dog keeps its own kill count in its window either way. Only zombie kills count; hunting is tracked separately.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip: When ON, a companion carrying a firearm never runs out: their reserve is quietly topped up so they keep reloading without you handing over magazines. When OFF (default), they only fire what you actually give them.
Sandbox_Vampire_EnableVampire_tooltip: Enables or disables all vampire mechanics.
Sandbox_Vampire_SunlightDamage_tooltip: Daytime blood decay added by sunlight. Higher = faster drain.
Sandbox_Vampire_SafeInteriorSP_tooltip: Singleplayer only: building interiors block sunlight (it does not pass through windows).
Sandbox_Vampire_FeedHealAmount_tooltip: Blood gained when feeding from a corpse or animal.
Sandbox_Vampire_InfectionOnBiteChance_to: Chance (percent) to infect the target when biting.
Sandbox_Vampire_NightBuffStrength_toolti: Reduces blood/thirst decay at night; higher = slower drain.
Sandbox_Vampire_LordAscensionKills_toolt: Zombie kills required to unlock Lord Vampire ascension.
Sandbox_Vampire_LordBloodTier1_tooltip: Blood ratio threshold for tier 1 bonuses (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordBloodTier2_tooltip: Blood ratio threshold for tier 2 bonuses (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordBloodRegenMin_toolti: Minimum blood ratio to enable dark regeneration (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordSurgeBloodMin_toolti: Minimum blood ratio to roll surge on kill (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordMeleeDmgT1_tooltip: Bonus melee damage at blood tier 1 (0-2).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordAttackSpeedT1_toolti: Bonus attack speed at blood tier 1 (0-2).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordShovePowerT1_tooltip: Bonus shove power at blood tier 1 (0-2).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordMeleeDmgT2_tooltip: Bonus melee damage at blood tier 2 (0-2).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordCritChanceT2_tooltip: Crit or knockdown bonus at blood tier 2 (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordSurgeChance_tooltip: Chance to trigger surge on kill (0-1).
Sandbox_Vampire_VisualNightSP_tooltip: Singleplayer only: visually darkens the world during the configured night window.
Sandbox_Vampire_VisualNightSPStrength_to: Singleplayer only: how dark the visual night becomes (1=soft, 5=intense).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordNightStrBonus_toolti: Strength bonus at night (fallback if supported).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordNightFitBonus_toolti: Fitness bonus at night (fallback if supported).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordNightStaminaRegen_to: Extra stamina regen per minute at night (0-2).
Sandbox_Vampire_LordRegenBleedReduce_too: Bleeding time reduced per regen tick.
Sandbox_Vampire_LordRegenScratchHeal_too: Scratch time reduced per regen tick.
Sandbox_Vampire_LordRegenCombatGraceSec_: Seconds after combat before regen starts.
Sandbox_Vampire_LordEvalIntervalSec_tool: Server update interval for Lord buffs.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.WalletMinCash_t: The minimum amount of money found in a wallet (if not empty).
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.WalletMaxCash_t: The maximum amount of money found in a normal wallet. Jackpots can exceed this.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.WalletEmptyChan: Percentage chance a wallet contains nothing but junk.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.WalletJackpotCh: Chance to hit the 'Tax Return' tier, granting max cash + bonus.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketWi: Chance that a randomized scratch ticket becomes a winner when scratched.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketJa: Extra chance for a winning ticket to jump to the live jackpot pool instead of a normal payout.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketMi: Minimum payout for a winning scratch ticket.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketMa: Maximum payout for a winning scratch ticket.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketLo: Relative weight for low-tier common wins after a ticket wins.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketMe: Relative weight for medium-tier common wins after a ticket wins.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketHi: Relative weight for high-tier common wins after a ticket wins.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketLo: Upper payout ceiling for low common wins as a percent of the configured max win.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketMe: Upper payout ceiling for medium common wins as a percent of the configured max win.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketHi: Upper payout ceiling for high common wins. Anything above this is reserved for jackpot payouts.
Sandbox_CurrencyExpanded.ScratchTicketJa: Multiplier applied to max win to build the base live jackpot before the rolling pool is added.
Scratch Ticket: Jackpot Growth Per Scratch
How much the live jackpot grows after each non-jackpot scratch.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestDifficult: Global multiplier for encounter-based objective spawns. Higher values spawn more quest zombies and raise the required kill count.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestExpiratio: Scales the base expiration for generated Dynamic Objectives quests. Set to 0 to disable quest expiration.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.RestingContrac: After the minimum resting quest family floor is satisfied, each remaining resting contract family gets this percent chance to appear as another available job.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumResting: Guarantees up to this many resting quest families are available when eligible traders exist. Missing families are filled before optional extras are rolled.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.EscortIncident: After the minimum escort incident floor is satisfied, this percent chance adds one extra pending escort incident when eligible traders exist.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumEscortI: Guarantees at least this many pending escort incidents when eligible traders and rescue sites exist. If the floor cannot be met, debug logs explain why.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardPoo: Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include weapon items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include medicine and medical-tool items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include food and drink items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include bag and backpack items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardMin: Minimum cash paid directly to the player when a Dynamic Objectives quest includes a money reward. Set to 0 to disable the floor.
Sandbox_Camouflage_WalkLikeAZombie_toolt:
Pretend to be one of them! Walk like an infected while camouflaged.
NOTE: You can configure a hotkey in the mod options to toggle this state.
Sandbox_Camouflage_AllowHotKey_tooltip:
Allow toggling between walking like an infected and walking normally.
The hotkey can be configured in the mod options.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NormalWalk_hotkey_too: While camouflaged, press this key to toggle between walking normally and walking like a zombie.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NoRunning_tooltip:
You should not run if you want to stay unnoticed.
Running within sight of infected reduces camouflage duration.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NoClimbing_tooltip:
Zombies don't climb walls, and neither should you.
Climbing walls within sight of infected drastically reduces camouflage duration.
Sandbox_Camouflage_StunDuration_tooltip: Determines how many seconds zombies remain confused while following the player's trail.
Sandbox_Camouflage_MinDistance_tooltip:
Determines the distance that camouflaged Players must keep from zombies to remain camouflaged.
Set to -1 to disable this gameplay mechanic.
Sandbox_Camouflage_Nausea_tooltip:
Determines how much nausea Players receive after camouflaging.
Set to 0 to disable this gameplay mechanic.
Sandbox_Camouflage_Legacy_tooltip:
Uses the original mod logic for zombies.
NOTE: It is recommended to set the minimum detection distance to 1.
Sandbox_PAR_RequireSlotCost_tooltip: When ON (default), adding or removing an attachment slot consumes materials (Leather Strips, Thread), requires Scissors + Needle, and a minimum Tailoring level. When OFF, adding and removing slots is free and needs no skill.
Sandbox_PAR_SlotTailoringLevel: Tailoring level to add a slot
Sandbox_PAR_SlotTailoringLevel_tooltip: Minimum Tailoring skill level required to add an attachment slot. Only applies when the slot cost option is ON. Removing a slot never requires a skill.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_EnableLootQu: Adds quality tiers and fitting bonuses to loot.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_QualityChanc: Multiplies the chance for Rare and higher tiers.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_RareChance_t: Base percent chance for Rare items.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_FactorySelec: Base percent chance for Factory Select items.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_Professional: Base percent chance for Professional Grade items.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_PrototypeCha: Base percent chance for Prototype items.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_BonusStrengt: Scales all quality bonuses up or down.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_RenameItems_: Adds the quality tier to item names for Rare and higher.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_ColoredInven: Colors Rare, Factory Select, Professional Grade and Prototype item names in inventory lists.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_ShowTooltips: Shows quality tier, type and bonuses in item tooltips.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_ApplyUtility: Apply to utility and special items
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_CrudeCrossbowSpawnMu: Multiplies how often crude crossbows spawn in loot.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_ImprovedCrossbowSpaw: Multiplies how often improved crossbows spawn in loot.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_CompoundCrossbowSpaw: Multiplies how often compound crossbows spawn in loot.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_HandCrossbowSpawnMul: Multiplies how often hand crossbows spawn in loot.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltWBaseBreakChance: Base chance that a lodged wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltWBreakChanceScal: Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Maintenance Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Maintenance level.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltSWBaseBreakChanc: Base chance that a lodged short wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltSWBreakChanceSca: Short Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Maintenance Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Maintenance level.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_FoodLevelRequirem: If Cooking levels are required to see extra food and liquid nutrition information.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_WeaponLevelRequir: If weapon skill levels are required to see extra melee weapon information.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_MaintenanceLevelR: If Maintenance levels are required to see extra weapon and item condition information.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMax: Backup delay in dangerous areas - max
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMax_: Maximum backup arrival time when call is from a dangerous location. Default 50 min.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMin: Backup delay in dangerous areas - min
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMin_: Minimum backup arrival time when call is from a dangerous location (many zombies, wilderness). Default 20 min.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMax_too: Maximum in-game minutes before backup arrives. Random pick between min and max. Default 25 min.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMin_too: Minimum in-game minutes before hostile backup arrives after being called by a defender. Default 6 min.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupSquadSize_to: How many NPCs arrive when a defender calls backup. Default 3.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableExecution_to: When ON, a Execute option appears on captured/surrendered NPCs (menu → execute). WARNING: dark themes. When OFF, only release/leave options.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioSystem_: When ON, NPCs can broadcast radio messages (help calls, faction news, warnings) that players tuned in can hear. When OFF, radio stays vanilla only.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioText: Show radio messages as chat text
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioText_to: When ON, radio broadcasts also appear as chat log entries (useful if audio hard to hear). When OFF, radio audio only.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableSurrender_to: When ON, surrendered hostiles can be captured. You may release them (relation boost), execute them (see next option), or leave them tied up. When OFF, no surrender mechanics.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableWeaponDrop: NPCs drop their weapons on death
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableWeaponDrop_t: When ON, NPCs' weapons and ammo are lootable from their corpse after death. When OFF, weapons disappear with body.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_RadioDropChance: Radio drop chance on NPC kill (%)
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_RadioDropChance_to: Percentage chance that a killed NPC drops a working radio you can tune to their faction's channel. Default 15%.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_SurrenderLootAmoun: Rarity of loot when you take from a surrendered NPC. 1=poor, 5=medium, 10=rich.
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalIcon_tooltip: When ON, a red (raid) or green (friendly) marker appears near screen edge when a new NPC group arrives at your position. When OFF, no early warning.
Sandbox_Bandits.BleedOut_tooltip: When ON, NPCs bleeding heavily may die minutes after combat ends without medical care. When OFF, NPCs stabilize automatically after combat.
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildBridge_tooltip: When ON, hostile Strangers mod clans may construct wooden bridges over rivers. Rare feature. When OFF, bridges are not built.
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildRoadblock_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may build small ambush roadblocks (cars, debris, snipers) on highways. When OFF, no roadblocks spawn.
Sandbox_Bandits.Captions_tooltip: When ON, colored text captions appear above NPC heads during combat ('Take cover!', 'Reloading!', 'Argh!'). Green=friendly, Red=hostile. When OFF, no captions.
Sandbox_Bandits.CarryTorches_tooltip: When ON, NPCs auto-equip flashlights/torches at night for visibility. When OFF, they walk in darkness.
Sandbox_Bandits.CorpseSwapper_tooltip: When ON, killed NPC corpses stay visible on ground with correct clothing/gear. When OFF, corpses may despawn or lose visual details.
Sandbox_Bandits.DefenderLootAmount_toolt: Rarity of items dropped when you kill a hostile NPC (guarding a base). 1=poor, 5=medium, 10=rich. Higher = more/rarer items on corpse.
Sandbox_Bandits.DensityScore_tooltip: When ON, NPCs spawn MORE often in cities/towns and LESS in wilderness. When OFF, spawn rate is uniform everywhere.
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyDoor_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs raiding your base will break down locked doors. When OFF, doors are impenetrable to NPCs.
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyThumpable_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can smash player-built walls, gates, and thumpable objects. When OFF, your builds are indestructible to NPCs (only zombies attack them).
Sandbox_Bandits.EnableHostileSurvivors_t: When ON, hostile NPC clans (Strangers, Criminals, Bikers, Mentals, etc — 16 hostile groups) spawn and attack you on sight. When OFF, ALL NPCs behave as neutral/friendly (no raids, no hostile encounters). Default ON for full apocalypse experience.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnterVehicles_tooltip: When ON, NPCs (companions + hostiles) can enter cars and use them (drive, ride shotgun, follow you in vehicles). When OFF, they stay on foot only.
Sandbox_Bandits.GeneratorCutoff_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may turn off your generator during a raid (leaving base dark/without power). When OFF, generator is safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option1:
Desperate Citizens                                                     
 First survivors of the apocalypse. They they owe their lives more to chance than to skill.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option10:
Hunters                                                                          
 A group that welcomed the new hunting season with pleasure, with no need for hunters license.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option11:
Holy Reclaimers                                                          
 A religious sect with a brand new set of 10 commandments.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option13:
Doomrider Clan                                                            
 A well-organized gang focused on mainly looting, with no remorse if someone dies along the way.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option14:
Private Militia                                                          
 Deserted from the army just before the government collapse, with access to unlimited weapons and ammo.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option15:
Death's Legion                                                            
 The most numerous, danegerous and best equipped clan around, supported by the richest man in Louisville.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option2:
Psychopaths                                                                   
 Incapable of feeling any fear or pain, simply left the Louisville hospital while others died in panic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option3:
Cannibals                                                                       
 Survived mainly by having high skill in wielding a cleaver, later by having access to high-protein food.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option4:
Criminals                                                                       
 Without unnecessary conscience nor moral constraints, easily adapted to the new conditions after the outbreak of the pandemic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option5:
Inmates                                                                           
 After the outbreak in Knox prison they managed to flee and resocialize with the new community.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option6:
Police                                                                             
 Called to serve and protect, having access to weapons from the first day, quickly seized the opportunity to form a gang.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option7:
Preppers                                                                         
 Lunatics who apparently were right about the end of the world, actually welcomed the first day of the apocalypse.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option8:
Veterans                                                                         
 The patriots, hardened by war, knew how to deal with the new enemy, and how not to lose their honor.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option9:
Boozehounds Brigade                                                   
 Daily visits to the local tavern cemented their friendship, survived by being together and working as a group.
Sandbox_Bandits.Infection_tooltip: When ON, NPCs bitten by zombies get infected and eventually turn into zombies themselves. When OFF, NPCs are immune to infection (they only die from wounds).
Sandbox_Bandits.KillCounter_tooltip: When ON, kills you make on NPCs (Survivors + Hostile NPCs) are counted in your player stats. When OFF, killing NPCs doesn't add to any counter.
Sandbox_Bandits.LimitedEndurance_tooltip: When ON, NPCs' movement/attack speed drops as endurance depletes (like players). When OFF, NPCs have infinite stamina.
Sandbox_Bandits.LostRestore_tooltip: When ON, recruited companions who wander too far or get stuck are automatically teleported back to you. When OFF, you must retrieve them manually (or lose them if they die off-screen).
Sandbox_Bandits.NPCLimitPerPlayer_toolti: Maximum number of NPCs one player can recruit as companions. 0 = no limit. Higher = larger crews possible but heavier CPU load.
Sandbox_Bandits.OriginalBandits_tooltip: When ON, only NPCs from HDX Strangers + other installed NPC mods spawn (no vanilla Strangers mod NPCs). When OFF, all NPC sources are allowed.
Sandbox_Bandits.RemoveBarricade_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can tear down wooden planks / metal sheets covering windows and doors. When OFF, barricades block them permanently.
Sandbox_Bandits.RunAway_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs at low HP or outnumbered may drop weapons and flee. When OFF, hostiles always fight to death (no retreat).
Sandbox_Bandits.SabotageCrops_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may trample/uproot your farming plots during raids. When OFF, crops are safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.SabotageVehicles_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may damage your parked vehicles (flat tires, broken engine, drained battery). When OFF, your vehicles are safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.SizeMultiplier_tooltip: When an NPC group spawns, how many members it has. 1.0 = clan config default, 2.0 = twice as many NPCs per spawn event.
Sandbox_Bandits.SmashWindow_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs can break windows to enter buildings. When OFF, they use doors only.
Sandbox_Bandits.SneakAtNight_tooltip: When ON, NPCs enter stealth mode at night — quieter movement, harder for zombies to detect. When OFF, they walk normally 24/7.
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnMultiplier_tooltip: Global multiplier for how often NPC groups spawn in the world. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as many spawn events, 0.5 = half. Affects both friendly Survivors and Hostile NPCs equally.
Sandbox_Bandits.StunlockHitSpeed_tooltip: How quickly the player's animation resets after being hit. HIGHER value = less time stunlocked = you recover faster. 1.0=slow (heavy stun), 3.0=near instant. Default 2.4.
Sandbox_Bandits.Surrender_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs at low HP may drop weapons and surrender. You can then execute or spare them (see Execution option). When OFF, hostile NPCs always fight to death.
Sandbox_Bandits.Theft_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can open your storage crates/lockers and take items during raids. When OFF, they ignore containers.
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors.CombatLog: Log NPC hits on players (admin diag)
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors.CombatLog_tooltip: [ADMIN] When ON, prints [HDX_COMBAT] log lines for every hostile NPC hit on a player (or friendly NPC damage). Lightweight, event-driven. Useful for diagnosing PvE deaths in dedicated servers.
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors.EnablePortrait3D_t: When ON, NPC portraits in the NPC panel are rendered in 3D (higher quality, correct outfits, real animations). When OFF, uses static 2D icons (lower CPU/GPU).
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors.NoFriendlyFire_too: When ON, damage between players and recruited companions is IGNORED (bullets whiff, melee misses). Also blocks companion-to-companion and player-to-non-hostile wanderer damage. Recommended for PVE. Turn OFF for hardcore/PVP where friendly fire is intentional. Hostile NPCs + zombies always take normal damage.
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors_CombatLog: Log hostile NPC hits on players
Sandbox_HDX_Survivors_CombatLog_tooltip: [ADMIN] When ON prints [HDX_COMBAT] log lines for every hostile NPC hit on a player. Lightweight, event-driven only. Useful for diagnosing PvE deaths.
Sandbox_Strangers.WelcomeAlly_tooltip: When ON, a friendly NPC spawns to greet you on first time entering the world (100%) and sometimes after death (10% chance). When OFF, no welcome ally ever spawns - you must find companions yourself. Recommended: ON for guided intro, OFF for pure survival experience.
Sandbox_FightZ_FistXpMultiplier_tooltip: XP multiplier used for the FightZ Fists perk when per-skill XP multipliers are enabled.
